title: Facture non réceptionnée
description: Requête importée automatiquement depuis l'export SQL Sage X3.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT PID.BPSNUM_0, PID.ACCDAT_0, PID.NUM_0, PID.QTYUOM_0, PID.PIDLIN_0, (PID.AMTNOTLIN_0 * PIH.RATMLT_0), PID.ITMREF_0, ITM.ITMDES1_0, PID.FCY_0, PID.POHNUM_0, PID.POPLIN_0  FROM PINVOICE PIH  LEFT OUTER JOIN PINVOICED PID                   ON PIH.NUM_0 = PID.NUM_0   and (PID.PTHNUM_0 ='' OR RTRIM(PID.PTHNUM_0) IS NULL)  LEFT OUTER JOIN BPSUPPLIER BPS                   ON PID.BPSNUM_0 = BPS.BPSNUM_0  RIGHT OUTER JOIN PORDER POH  ON ((PID.POHNUM_0 = POH.POHNUM_0)  and PID.POHNUM_0 IS NOT NULL)  LEFT OUTER JOIN PORDERQ POQ  ON POH.POHNUM_0 = POQ.POHNUM_0 and POQ.POPLIN_0 = PID.POPLIN_0  LEFT OUTER JOIN PRECEIPTD PTD   ON  POQ.POHNUM_0 = PTD.POHNUM_0 and POQ.POPLIN_0 = PTD.POPLIN_0    RIGHT OUTER JOIN ITMMASTER ITM                        ON PID.ITMREF_0 = ITM.ITMREF_0 and ITM.STOMGTCOD_0 <>1  WHERE BPS.BPSNUM_0 >= %4%   and (BPS.BPSNUM_0 <= %5% OR RTRIM(%5%) IS NULL OR RTRIM(%5%)='')             and (PID.NUM_0 >= %6% OR RTRIM(%6%) IS NULL OR RTRIM(%6%)='') and (PID.NUM_0 <= %7% OR RTRIM(%7%) IS NULL OR RTRIM(%7%)='')  and (PID.POHNUM_0 >= %8% OR RTRIM(%8%) IS NULL OR RTRIM(%8%)='') and (PID.POHNUM_0 <= %9% OR RTRIM(%9%) IS NULL OR RTRIM(%9%)='')  and ((PID.FCY_0 >= %2% OR RTRIM(%2%) IS NULL OR RTRIM(%2%)='') and (PID.FCY_0 <= %3% OR RTRIM(%3%) IS NULL OR RTRIM(%3%)=''))  and (%1% = convert(datetime,'20000101',112) or (PID.ACCDAT_0 IS NOT NULL and PID.ACCDAT_0 <= %1%))  and (PID.AMTNOTLIN_0 * COALESCE(PIH.RATMLT_0,1))<>0  and (POQ.PTHNUM_0 ='')                                                                  ORDER BY PID.FCY_0, PID.NUM_0, PID.PIDLIN_0

sql: # VEN-056   # Requête SQL pour trouver les clients sans commande depuis X jours   # Depuis une date de référence !  # Lien avec Profil fonction site (AFCTFCY)    SELECT DISTINCT BPC.BPCNUM_0, BPC.BPCNAM_0, SOH.ORDDAT_0      FROM BPCUSTOMER  BPC  LEFT OUTER JOIN SORDER SOH      ON BPC.BPCNUM_0 = SOH.BPCORD_0      AND SOH.ORDDAT_0 < %1% - %2%  INNER JOIN AFCTFCY AFF               ON (SOH.SALFCY_0 =  AFF.FCY_0 and  AFF.PRFCOD_0 = %GPROFIL% and AFF.FNC_0 = %GUSRFCT%)  WHERE  BPC.BPCNUM_0 >= %3%  AND (BPC.BPCNUM_0 <= %4%  OR RTRIM(%4%) IS NULL OR RTRIM(%4%)='')   AND BPC.BPCNAM_0 >= %5%  AND (BPC.BPCNAM_0 <= %6%  OR RTRIM(%6%) IS NULL OR RTRIM(%6%)='')         ORDER BY BPC.BPCNUM_0

sql: SELECT      da.CREUSR_0      AS createur,      da.REQUSR_0      AS demandeur,      da.YALIVUSR_0    AS a_liver,        d.BPSNUM_0       AS fournisseur,      s.BPSNAM_0       AS nom_frs,        o.PSHNUM_0       AS num_da,      o.PSDLIN_0       AS lig_da,      o.POHNUM_0       AS num_cde,      o.POPLIN_0       AS lig_cde,        d.ITMREF_0       AS article,      d.ITMDES_0       AS designation,        po.QTYUOM_0      AS qte_cdee,      po.RCPQTYPUU_0   AS qte_recep,      po.PTHNUM_0      AS num_recpt  FROM PREQUISO o  INNER JOIN PREQUIS da          ON da.PSHNUM_0 = o.PSHNUM_0  INNER JOIN PREQUISD d          ON d.PSHNUM_0 = o.PSHNUM_0         AND d.PSDLIN_0 = o.POPLIN_0  INNER JOIN PORDER hd          ON hd.POHNUM_0 = o.POHNUM_0  INNER JOIN PORDERQ po          ON po.POHNUM_0 = o.POHNUM_0         AND po.POPLIN_0 = o.POPLIN_0  INNER JOIN BPSUPPLIER s          ON s.BPSNUM_0 = d.BPSNUM_0  WHERE          po.QTYUOM_0 <> po.RCPQTYPUU_0      AND hd.CLEFLG_0 < 2      AND (              da.CREUSR_0   = %1%           OR da.REQUSR_0   = %1%           OR da.YALIVUSR_0 = %1%          );

title: Test ZACCES3
description: Requête importée automatiquement depuis l'export SQL Sage X3.
sql: SELECT      /* ===== Identification ===== */      stj.STOFCY_0              AS [Site],      stj.ITMREF_0              AS [Article],      itm.ITMDES1_0             AS [Désignation 1],      stj.IPTDAT_0              AS [Date imputation],      stj.LOT_0                 AS [Lot],        /* ===== Quantités ===== */      SUM(stj.QTYPCU_0)         AS [Cumul Quantité],      stj.PCU_0                 AS [UC],      SUM(stj.QTYSTU_0)         AS [Cumul Quantité US],      stj.STU_0                 AS [US],        /* ===== Mouvement / Pièce ===== */      stj.TRSTYP_0              AS [Type mouvement],      stj.VCRTYP_0              AS [Type pièce],      stj.VCRTYPORI_0           AS [Type pièce origine],        /* ===== Lot / Origine ===== */      stj.BPSLOT_0              AS [Lot fournisseur],      stj.POT_0                 AS [Titre],        /* ===== Valorisation ===== */      SUM(stj.ACTQTY_0)         AS [Quantité active],      SUM(stj.AMTORD_0)         AS [Cumul Montant ordre],      SUM(stj.AMTVAL_0)         AS [Cumul Montant mouvement],      stj.PRIVAL_0              AS [Prix valorisé],      SUM(stj.VARORD_0)         AS [Variation ordre],      stj.PRINAT_0              AS [Nature prix origine],      SUM(stj.VARVAL_0)         AS [Variation mouvement],      stj.PRIORD_0              AS [Prix ordre],        /* ===== Analytique ===== */      stj.CCE_0                 AS [COC],      stj.CCE_1                 AS [BUS],      stj.CCE_2                 AS [PRJ],        /* ===== Fournisseur (issu réception) ===== */      stj2.BPRNUM_0             AS [Code fournisseur],      bps.BPSNAM_0              AS [RS fournisseur]    FROM STOJOU stj  INNER JOIN ITMMASTER itm      ON itm.ITMREF_0 = stj.ITMREF_0    LEFT JOIN STOJOU stj2      ON stj2.ITMREF_0 = stj.ITMREF_0     AND stj2.LOT_0 = stj.LOT_0     AND stj2.TRSFAM_0 = 'REC'    LEFT JOIN BPSUPPLIER bps      ON bps.BPSNUM_0 = stj2.BPRNUM_0    WHERE      (stj.CREDAT_0 >= %1% OR %1% <= '2000-01-01')  AND (stj.CREDAT_0 <= %2% OR %2% <= '2000-01-01')  AND (stj.IPTDAT_0 >= %3% OR %3% <= '2000-01-01')  AND (stj.IPTDAT_0 <= %4% OR %4% <= '2000-01-01')  AND (stj.ITMREF_0 = %5% OR %5% = '')  AND (itm.TCLCOD_0 BETWEEN %6% AND %7% OR (%6% = '' AND %7% = ''))    AND (         (%8% = '2' AND stj.TRSTYP_0 NOT IN (7,8,9,21,25) AND stj.VCRTYP_0 NOT IN (35))      OR (%9% = '2' AND (stj.TRSTYP_0 IN (7,8,9,21,25) OR stj.VCRTYP_0 IN (35)))      OR (%10% = '2' AND stj.TRSTYP_0 IN (23))  )    AND stj.REGFLG_0 <= %11%  AND stj.TRSTYP_0 <> 0  AND stj.UPDCOD_0 = 2  AND (itm.YACTCOD_0 >= %12% AND itm.YACTCOD_0 <= %13%)  AND ((%14% = '' AND %15% = '') OR (stj2.BPRNUM_0 BETWEEN %14% AND %15%))    GROUP BY      stj.STOFCY_0,      stj.ITMREF_0,      itm.ITMDES1_0,      stj.IPTDAT_0,      stj.LOT_0,      stj.PCU_0,      stj.STU_0,      stj.TRSTYP_0,      stj.VCRTYP_0,      stj.VCRTYPORI_0,      stj.BPSLOT_0,      stj.POT_0,      stj.PRIVAL_0,      stj.PRINAT_0,      stj.PRIORD_0,      stj.CCE_0,      stj.CCE_1,      stj.CCE_2,      stj2.BPRNUM_0,      bps.BPSNAM_0;

sql: SELECT        ITM.YACTCOD_0,      QC.XVCRNUMORI_0,      QC.XITMREF_0,      ITM.ITMDES1_0,      QC.XREQNUM_0,      QC.XOUVDAT_0,      QC.XENDDAT_0,        CASE           WHEN QC.XTRANSAC_0 = 17 THEN 'FLUIDES'          WHEN QC.XTRANSAC_0 = 11 THEN 'STAB'          ELSE 'AUTRE'      END AS [Type QC]    FROM XREQUESTH QC  JOIN ITMMASTER ITM       ON QC.XITMREF_0 = ITM.ITMREF_0  WHERE   (      QC.XTRANSAC_0 = 17      AND QC.XSTATUT_0 < 3      AND QC.XCLODAT_0 < GETDATE() + 3  )  OR  (      QC.XTRANSAC_0 = 11      AND QC.XSTATUT_0 < 4  );

title: GDD - Extract Activité (PF).
description: Requête importée automatiquement depuis l'export SQL Sage X3.
sql: #   #     select distinct           stk.ITMREF_0,          itm.ITMDES1_0,          itm.TCLCOD_0,          stk.LOT_0,          stk.STA_0,          sum(stk.QTYPCU_0) as Stock,          (Select round(sum(itc.MATTOT_0 + itc.MACTOT_0 + itc.LABTOT_0 + itc.SCOTOT_0 +                      itc.OVETOT_0),5)            from ITMCOST itc           where itc.ITMREF_0 = stk.ITMREF_0 and itc.FIYNUM_0 = 4 and itc.CSTTYP_0 = 1            group by itc.ITMREF_0)          as ValQTY,          sum(stk.QTYPCU_0) * (Select sum(itc.MATTOT_0 + itc.MACTOT_0 + itc.LABTOT_0 +                                          itc.SCOTOT_0 + itc.OVETOT_0)                                from ITMCOST itc                               where itc.ITMREF_0 = stk.ITMREF_0 and itc.FIYNUM_0 = 4                                and itc.CSTTYP_0 = 1                                group by itc.ITMREF_0)          as Valorisation,          (Select min(lot.SHLDAT_0)            from STOLOT lot           where lot.LOT_0 = stk.LOT_0 and lot.ITMREF_0 = stk.ITMREF_0            group by lot.ITMREF_0, lot.LOT_0)          as Dt_Péremption    from BOMD bom  right outer join STOCK stk on bom.CPNITMREF_0 = stk.ITMREF_0   join ITMMASTER  itm on itm.ITMREF_0 = stk.ITMREF_0     where bom.ITMREF_0 is NULL and (itm.TCLCOD_0 <> 'PFV' and itm.TCLCOD_0 <> 'MPROD')     group by  stk.ITMREF_0, itm.ITMDES1_0, itm.TCLCOD_0,              stk.LOT_0, stk.STA_0     order by  stk.ITMREF_0, itm.ITMDES1_0, itm.TCLCOD_0,             stk.LOT_0, stk.STA_0

sql: # Ticket GLPI 3401   # Requête SQL pour trouver les articles catégories ADCP & XSTAT00="AL", et ADCS  # Ajout 30/05/2016 ajouter catégories ADCP & ADCS complètes + ANL et articles 81* & 85*  # Ajout 10/06/2016 ajouter XSTAT12 () et test date validité Version Article  # Ajout 07/06/2016 supprimer test article inactif.     Select B.CPNITMREF_0, itml.ITMDES1_0, sum(sto.QTYSTU_0) as totQTY, sum((cou.MATTOT_0 + cou.MACTOT_0 + cou.LABTOT_0 + cou.SCOTOT_0 + cou.OVETOT_0)*sto.QTYSTU_0) as  totSTD, B.ITMREF_0, a12.TEXTE_0,vers.XVERSION_0, MIN(vers.XVERSTRDAT_0), MAX(vers.XVERENDDAT_0)    # ITMMASTER - Articles  # BOMD - Lignes Nomenclatures   # ITMFACILIT - Articles - Sites   # XITMVERSIO - Version article   # XITMSTAT - Statistiques articles   # STOCK - Stocks  # ITMCOST - Articles - Coûts  # ITMMASTER - Articles 2  # XITMSTAT - Statistiques articles 2  # ATEXTRA - Textes à traduire  # ATABDIV - Tables diverses    from ITMMASTER itm  Join BOMD B on (B.CPNITMREF_0=itm.ITMREF_0 and (itm.TCLCOD_0 <> 'PFV' and itm.TCLCOD_0   <> 'PI'))    Join ITMFACILIT ITF on ITF.ITMREF_0=B.CPNITMREF_0 and ITF.STOFCY_0='FAMB1'  left join XITMVERSIO vers on vers.ITMREF_0=B.ITMREF_0 and vers.BOMALT_0=B.BOMALT_0 and  vers.XGESCOUT_0 <> 2 and vers.XPLANIF_0 = 2    left join XITMSTAT XIS on XIS.ITMREF_0=B.CPNITMREF_0  left join STOCK sto on sto.ITMREF_0=B.CPNITMREF_0  left join ITMCOST cou on cou.ITMREF_0=B.CPNITMREF_0 and cou.STOFCY_0='FAMB1' and cou.CSTTYP_0=1 and cou.FIYNUM_0=4  left join ITMMASTER itml on itml.ITMREF_0=B.CPNITMREF_0  left join XITMSTAT xis12 on xis12.ITMREF_0=B.ITMREF_0  left join ATEXTRA a12 on xis12.XSTAT12_0<>'NA' and xis12.XSTAT12_0=a12.IDENT2_0 and a12.CODFIC_0='ATABDIV' and a12.ZONE_0='LNGDES' and a12.LANGUE_0='FRA' and a12.IDENT1_0='1212'      Where ((itm.TCLCOD_0 = 'ADCP')    # and (XIS.XSTAT00_0='AL'))   or (itm.TCLCOD_0 = 'ADCS')   or (itm.TCLCOD_0 = 'ANL'          and (left(B.CPNITMREF_0, 2) = '70'))  or (itm.TCLCOD_0 = 'ANL'         and (left(B.CPNITMREF_0, 2) = '71'))  or (itm.TCLCOD_0 = 'ANL'          and (left(B.CPNITMREF_0, 2) = '81'))  or (itm.TCLCOD_0 = 'ANL'         and (left(B.CPNITMREF_0, 2) = '85'))  or (itm.TCLCOD_0 = 'ANL'          and (left(B.CPNITMREF_0, 2) = '87'))  or (itm.TCLCOD_0 = 'ANL'         and (left(B.CPNITMREF_0, 2) = '89')))  and ((vers.XVERENDDAT_0 = %2%) or (vers.XVERENDDAT_0 >= %1%))    Group by B.CPNITMREF_0, itml.ITMDES1_0, vers.XVERSION_0,  vers.XVERSTRDAT_0, vers.XVERENDDAT_0, B.ITMREF_0, a12.TEXTE_0  Order by  B.CPNITMREF_0, vers.XVERSION_0;

sql: SELECT       SOH.CREDAT_0,      SOP.BPCORD_0,      BPC.BPCNAM_0,      SOH.ORDDAT_0,      SOP.SOHNUM_0,      SOH.EECICT_0 AS Incoterm,      SOH.ORDSTA_0,      SOP.SOPLIN_0,      CPT.CCE_1,      SOP.ITMREF_0,      SOP.ITMREFBPC_0,      ITM.ITMDES1_0,      SOQ.XDLVDATORI_0,      SOQ.DEMDLVDAT_0,      SOQ.QTY_0,      SOP.SAU_0,      SOP.NETPRINOT_0,      SOP.NETPRINOT_0 * SOQ.QTY_0 AS Montant_HT,      SUM(SDD.QTY_0) AS Quantité_livrée,      MAX(ISNULL(STO1.LOT_0, STO2.LOT_0)) AS LOT,      COUNT(DISTINCT ISNULL(STO1.LOT_0, STO2.LOT_0)) AS Nb_LOTS,      MAX(SDD.SHIDAT_0) AS Date_Livraison_Max,      MAX(SID.INVDAT_0) AS Date_Facture_Max,      SUM(SID.AMTNOTLIN_0) AS Total_Montant_Facture  FROM       SORDERP SOP      INNER JOIN SORDER SOH ON SOH.SOHNUM_0 = SOP.SOHNUM_0      LEFT JOIN BPCUSTOMER BPC ON BPC.BPCNUM_0 = SOP.BPCORD_0      LEFT JOIN SORDERQ SOQ ON SOQ.SOHNUM_0 = SOP.SOHNUM_0 AND SOQ.SOPLIN_0 = SOP.SOPLIN_0 AND SOQ.SOQSEQ_0 = SOP.SOPSEQ_0      LEFT JOIN CPTANALIN CPT ON CPT.VCRNUM_0 = SOP.SOHNUM_0 AND CPT.VCRLIN_0 = SOP.SOPLIN_0 AND CPT.VCRSEQ_0 = SOP.SOPSEQ_0      LEFT JOIN ITMMASTER ITM ON ITM.ITMREF_0 = SOP.ITMREF_0      LEFT JOIN SDELIVERYD SDD ON SDD.SOHNUM_0 = SOP.SOHNUM_0 AND SDD.SOPLIN_0 = SOP.SOPLIN_0 AND SDD.SOQSEQ_0 = SOP.SOPSEQ_0      LEFT JOIN STOALL STA1 ON STA1.VCRNUM_0 = SOP.SOHNUM_0 AND STA1.VCRLIN_0 = SOP.SOPLIN_0 AND STA1.VCRSEQ_0 = SOP.SOPSEQ_0      LEFT JOIN STOCK STO1 ON STO1.STOFCY_0 = STA1.STOFCY_0 AND STO1.STOCOU_0 = STA1.STOCOU_0      LEFT JOIN STOALL STA2 ON STA2.VCRNUM_0 = SDD.SDHNUM_0 AND STA2.VCRLIN_0 = SDD.SDDLIN_0      LEFT JOIN STOCK STO2 ON STO2.STOFCY_0 = STA2.STOFCY_0 AND STO2.STOCOU_0 = STA2.STOCOU_0      LEFT JOIN SINVOICED SID ON SID.SOHNUM_0 = SOP.SOHNUM_0 AND SID.SOPLIN_0 = SOP.SOPLIN_0 AND SID.SOQSEQ_0 = SOP.SOPSEQ_0  WHERE       (%1% = '' OR CPT.CCE_1 = %1%)      AND (%2% = '01-JAN-00' OR SOH.CREDAT_0 >= %2%)      AND (%3% = '01-JAN-00' OR SOH.CREDAT_0 <= %3%)      AND (%4% = '01-JAN-00' OR SOH.ORDDAT_0 >= %4%)      AND (%5% = '01-JAN-00' OR SOH.ORDDAT_0 <= %5%)      AND (%6% = '01-JAN-00' OR SOQ.XDLVDATORI_0 >= %6%)      AND (%7% = '01-JAN-00' OR SOQ.XDLVDATORI_0 <= %7%)      AND (%8% = '01-JAN-00' OR SOQ.DEMDLVDAT_0 >= %8%)      AND (%9% = '01-JAN-00' OR SOQ.DEMDLVDAT_0 <= %9%)  GROUP BY       SOH.CREDAT_0,      SOP.BPCORD_0,      BPC.BPCNAM_0,      SOH.ORDDAT_0,      SOP.SOHNUM_0,      SOH.EECICT_0,      SOH.ORDSTA_0,      SOP.SOPLIN_0,      CPT.CCE_1,      SOP.ITMREF_0,      SOP.ITMREFBPC_0,      ITM.ITMDES1_0,      SOQ.XDLVDATORI_0,      SOQ.DEMDLVDAT_0,      SOQ.QTY_0,      SOP.SAU_0,      SOP.NETPRINOT_0,      SOP.NETPRINOT_0 * SOQ.QTY_0  HAVING      (%10% = '01-JAN-00' OR MAX(SDD.SHIDAT_0) >= %10%)      AND (%11% = '01-JAN-00' OR MAX(SDD.SHIDAT_0) <= %11%)      AND (%12% = '01-JAN-00' OR MAX(SID.INVDAT_0) >= %12%)      AND (%13% = '01-JAN-00' OR MAX(SID.INVDAT_0) <= %13%)

title: Analyse sortie de stock

sql: SELECT       b.STOFCY_0,      b.TCLCOD_0,      b.ITMREF_0,      b.ITMDES1_0,      b.TSICOD_0,      b.TSICOD_1,      b.YACTCOD_0,      b.LOT_0,      b.FactureAvance,      b.XPROVCUST_0,      b.QTESTOCK_0,      ISNULL(s.QTE_EXPED, 0) AS QTE_EXPED,      ISNULL(s.QTE_SORTIE_DIV, 0) AS QTE_SORTIE_DIV,      ISNULL(f.QTYSTUFAC_0, 0) AS QTYSTUFAC_0,      ISNULL(f.AMTNOTLINFAC_0, 0) AS AMTNOTLINFAC_0,      ISNULL(f.QTYSTUAVO_0, 0) AS QTYSTUAVO_0,      ISNULL(f.AMTNOTLINAVO_0, 0) AS AMTNOTLINAVO_0  FROM  (      /* Base : stocks par article, lot, entrepôt */      SELECT           itf.STOFCY_0,          itm.TCLCOD_0,          itf.ITMREF_0,          itm.ITMDES1_0,          itm.TSICOD_0,          itm.TSICOD_1,          itm.YACTCOD_0,          sto.LOT_0,          SUM(sto.QTYSTU_0) AS QTESTOCK_0,          CASE WHEN ISNULL(sto.XFAVFLG_0, '') <> '' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS FactureAvance,          itm.XPROVCUST_0      FROM ITMFACILIT itf      INNER JOIN ITMMASTER itm ON itm.ITMREF_0 = itf.ITMREF_0      LEFT JOIN STOCK sto ON itf.ITMREF_0 = sto.ITMREF_0 AND itf.STOFCY_0 = sto.STOFCY_0      WHERE itm.ITMSTA_0 = 1         AND itm.STOMGTCOD_0 = 2      GROUP BY           itf.STOFCY_0,          itm.TCLCOD_0,          itf.ITMREF_0,          itm.ITMDES1_0,          itm.TSICOD_0,          itm.TSICOD_1,          itm.YACTCOD_0,          sto.LOT_0,          CASE WHEN ISNULL(sto.XFAVFLG_0, '') <> '' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END,          itm.XPROVCUST_0  ) b  LEFT JOIN   (      /* Sorties stock par type */      SELECT            stj.STOFCY_0,          stj.ITMREF_0,          stj.LOT_0,          SUM(CASE WHEN TRSTYP_0 = 4 THEN QTYSTU_0 ELSE 0 END) AS QTE_EXPED,          SUM(CASE WHEN TRSTYP_0 = 2 THEN QTYSTU_0 ELSE 0 END) AS QTE_SORTIE_DIV      FROM STOJOU stj       WHERE TRSTYP_0 IN (2, 4)        AND stj.IPTDAT_0 >= %1%      GROUP BY stj.STOFCY_0, stj.ITMREF_0, stj.LOT_0  ) s ON b.ITMREF_0 = s.ITMREF_0       AND b.LOT_0 = s.LOT_0       AND b.STOFCY_0 = s.STOFCY_0  LEFT JOIN   (      /* Facturation */      SELECT           sih.FCY_0 AS STOFCY_0,          sid.ITMREF_0,          sid.LOT_0,          sih.SIVTYP_0,          SUM(CASE WHEN INVTYP_0 = 1 THEN sid.QTYSTU_0 ELSE 0 END) AS QTYSTUFAC_0,          SUM(CASE WHEN INVTYP_0 = 1 THEN sid.AMTNOTLIN_0 ELSE 0 END) AS AMTNOTLINFAC_0,          SUM(CASE WHEN INVTYP_0 = 2 THEN sid.QTYSTU_0 ELSE 0 END) AS QTYSTUAVO_0,          SUM(CASE WHEN INVTYP_0 = 2 THEN sid.AMTNOTLIN_0 ELSE 0 END) AS AMTNOTLINAVO_0      FROM SINVOICED sid       INNER JOIN SINVOICE sih ON sid.NUM_0 = sih.NUM_0      WHERE sih.ACCDAT_0 >= %1%      GROUP BY sih.FCY_0, sid.ITMREF_0, sid.LOT_0, sih.SIVTYP_0  ) f ON b.ITMREF_0 = f.ITMREF_0       AND b.LOT_0 = f.LOT_0       AND b.STOFCY_0 = f.STOFCY_0

INV.SNS_0) * INV.RATMLT_0 AS AMTNOTLIN_MLT,      (INVD.AMTATILIN_0 * INV.SNS_0) * INV.RATMLT_0 AS AMTATILIN_MLT,        INV.VAC_0,      INVD.PJT_0,      INVD.POHNUM_0,      INVD.PTHNUM_0,      INVD.PNHNUM_0,      INVD.FCY_0,        STO.LOT_0,      ITMM.STOMGTCOD_0,      ITMM.DEFPOT_0,        CASE          WHEN (INVD.QTYSTU_0 * ITMM.DEFPOT_0) > 0              THEN (INVD.QTYSTU_0 * ITMM.DEFPOT_0) / 100          ELSE INVD.QTYSTU_0 * INV.SNS_0      END AS QTE_CALC,        CASE          WHEN (INVD.QTYSTU_0 * ITMM.DEFPOT_0) > 0              THEN (INVD.AMTNOTLIN_0 * INV.RATMLT_0)                   / (INVD.QTYSTU_0 * ITMM.DEFPOT_0 / 100)                   * INV.SNS_0          WHEN INVD.QTYSTU_0 > 0              THEN (INVD.AMTNOTLIN_0 * INV.RATMLT_0) / INVD.QTYSTU_0          ELSE INVD.AMTNOTLIN_0 * INV.RATMLT_0      END AS PRIX_UNITAIRE  FROM PINVOICE INV  INNER JOIN PINVOICED INVD          ON INV.NUM_0 = INVD.NUM_0  INNER JOIN PINVOICEV INVV          ON INV.NUM_0 = INVV.NUM_0  LEFT JOIN STOLOT STO          ON STO.ITMREF_0 = INVD.ITMREF_0         AND STO.VCRNUM_0 = INVD.PTHNUM_0         AND STO.VCRLIN_0 = INVD.PIDLIN_0  INNER JOIN ITMFACILIT ITMF          ON ITMF.ITMREF_0 = %12% OR %11% = ' ')  AND (INVD.PJT_0    BETWEEN %13% AND %14% OR %13% = ' ')  AND (INVD.POHNUM_0 BETWEEN %15% AND %16% OR %15% = ' ')  AND (INVD.PTHNUM_0 BETWEEN %17% AND %18% OR %17% = ' ')  AND (INVD.PNHNUM_0 BETWEEN %19% AND %20% OR %19% = ' ')  AND (STO.LOT_0     BETWEEN %21% AND %22% OR %21% = ' ')  AND (STO.SLO_0     BETWEEN %23% AND %24% OR %23% = ' ')  AND (ITMM.STOMGTCOD_0 BETWEEN title: Droits fonction GESPAY

sql: # Liste des utilisateurs ayant le droit de d'accéder à la fonction GESPAY (Règlements) - Fonction et accés.    select aut.NOMUSR_0 as 'Nom Utilisateur'          ,aut.USR_0 as 'Trigramme'            ,case            when aut.ENAFLG_0 <> 2 then 'Inactif'            else 'Actif'          end as 'Statut'            ,aft.PRFCOD_0 as 'Code Profil'         ,afc.ALLFCT_0 as 'Toutes fonctions'                ,aft.FNC_0 as 'Fonction'         ,aft.ACS_0 as 'Droit'         ,aft.OPT_0 as 'Option'         ,afc.ALLACS_0 as 'Tout accés'         ,acc.CODACC_0 as 'Code d acces'         ,acc.CONSUL_0 as 'Consultation'         ,acc.EXEC_0 as 'Exécution'         ,acc.MODIF_0 as 'Modification'           from AUTILIS aut  join AFCTFCT afc on afc.PRFCOD_0 = aut.PRFFCT_0  left join AFCTPRF aft on aft.PRFCOD_0 = afc.PRFCOD_0  left join ACCES acc on acc.PRFCOD_0 = aft.PRFCOD_0    where  (aut.ENAFLG_0 = 2              /* Pour les profils actifs              */         and aft.FNC_0 = 'GESPAY'      /* Avec fonction accès aux règlements */         and aft.ACS_0 = 2             /* Doit avoir accès à la fonction       */         and aft.OPT_0 <> ' '          /* Doit avoir des droits sur la fonction*/         and (acc.CODACC_0 = 'MODIFBPS' or acc.CODACC_0 = 'MODIFBPSS')         and aut.USR_0 <> 'VMI'  /* Exclusion du profil interface VMI */)  or          (afc.ALLFCT_0 = '2'        /* Pour les profils toutes fonctions   */           and aut.ENAFLG_0 = 2       /* pour les profils actifs */                      and aut.USR_0 <> 'BATCH'           and aut.USR_0 <> 'ADMIN' )       order by   aft.PRFCOD_0            ,aut.NOMUSR_0

    POHNUM_0,          POPLIN_0,          POQSEQ_0,          COUNT(DISTINCT PTHNUM_0) NB_REC_0,          SUM(LINAMT_0) MT_REC_0      FROM PRECEIPTD      GROUP BY POHNUM_0, POPLIN_0, POQSEQ_0  ) ptd        ON ptd.POHNUM_0 = pop.POHNUM_0      AND ptd.POPLIN_0 = pop.POPLIN_0     AND ptd.POQSEQ_0 = pop.POPSEQ_0  LEFT JOIN (      SELECT           pid.POHNUM_0,          pid.POPLIN_0, AND poh.ORDDAT_0 BETWEEN %7% AND %8%  GROUP BY   pso.PSHNUM_0,  pop.POHNUM_0,  poh.BPRNAM_0,  poh.BPSNUM_0,  poh.TOTLINAMT_0,  cal.CCE_0,  cal.CCE_1,  cal.CCE_2,  cal.ACC_1,  pop.POPLIN_0, ITC.STOFCY_0 = %1%     AND ITC.CSTTYP_0 BETWEEN %9% AND %10%     AND %2% BETWEEN ITC.ITCSTRDAT_0 AND ITC.ITCENDDAT_0     AND ITC.ITCSEQ_0 = (          SELECT MAX(ITC2.ITCSEQ_0)          FROM ITMCOST ITC2          WHERE ITC2.ITMREF_0 = ITC.ITMREF_0            AND ITC2.CSTTYP_0 = ITC.CSTTYP_0            AND %2% BETWEEN ITC2.ITCSTRDAT_0 AND ITC2.ITCENDDAT_0     )    LEFT JOIN BOM BOM      ON BOM.ITMREF_0 = ITM.ITMREF_0     AND BOM.BOMALT_0 = ITC.BOMALT_0    LEFT JOIN ATEXTRA FAM      ON FAM.CODFIC_0 = 'ATABDIV'     AND FAM.ZONE_0 = 'LNGDES'     AND FAM.IDENT1_0 = '21'     AND FAM.IDENT2_0 = ITM.TSICOD_1    LEFT JOIN ATEXTRA CLA      ON CLA.CODFIC_0 = 'ATABDIV'     AND CLA.ZONE_0 = 'LNGDES'     AND CLA.IDENT1_0 = '20'     AND CLA.IDENT2_0 = ITM.TSICOD_0    LEFT JOIN XITMVERSIO XIV      ON XIV.ITMREF_0 = ITM.ITMREF_0     AND %2% BETWEEN XIV.XVERSTRDAT_0 AND XIV.XVERENDDAT_0     AND XIV.XPLANIF_0 = 2     AND XIV.XVERSBLOQ_0 = 1    LEFT JOIN BOM BOM2      ON BOM2.ITMREF_0 = ITM.ITMREF_0     AND BOM2.BOMALT_0 = XIV.BOMALT_0    WHERE      (ITM.ITMREF_0 >= %5% OR %5% = '')  AND (ITM.ITMREF_0 <= %6% OR %6% = '')  AND (ITM.TCLCOD_0 >= %3% OR %3% = '')  AND (ITM.TCLCOD_0 <= %4% OR %4% = '')  AND (ITM.TSICOD_1 >= %7% OR %7% = '')  AND (ITM.TSICOD_1 <= %8% OR %8% = '')  AND ITM.STOMGTCOD_0 >= %11%  AND ITM.ITMSTA_0 BETWEEN %12% AND %13%;

title: Statut stock alloué change
description: Requête importée automatiquement depuis l'export SQL Sage X3.
sql: select stl.ITMREF_0 as 'Article',   stl.LOT_0 as 'Lot',   itm.ITMDES1_0 as 'Désignation 1',   stl.SLO_0 as 'Carton',    sto.LOC_0 as 'Emplacement',   stl.NEWLTIDAT_0 as 'Date recontrôle',    stl.SHLDAT_0 as 'Date péremption',    sto.STA_0 as 'Statut',   sto.QTYSTU_0 as 'Quantité US',    sta.VCRTYP_0 as 'Type pièce',   sta.VCRNUM_0 as 'No pièce'  from STOALL sta  inner join STOCK sto on sta.STOCOU_0=sto.STOCOU_0 and sta.STOFCY_0=sto.STOFCY_0  inner join STOLOT stl on sto.ITMREF_0=sta.ITMREF_0 and sto.LOT_0=stl.LOT_0 and sto.SLO_0=stl.SLO_0  inner join ITMMASTER itm on stl.ITMREF_0=itm.ITMREF_0  where stl.SHLDAT_0 > '01/01/1900' and (stl.SHLDAT_0 <= (getdate() +%1%) or stl.NEWLTIDAT_0 <= (GETDATE() + %1%))  order by  stl.ITMREF_0, stl.LOT_0 , stl.SLO_0

title: Stock arrivant en péremp.
description: Requête importée automatiquement depuis l'export SQL Sage X3.
sql: SELECT       stl.ITMREF_0       AS Article,      stl.LOT_0          AS Lot,      itm.ITMDES1_0      AS [Désignation 1],      sto.PALNUM_0       AS Palette,      stl.SLO_0          AS Carton,      stoloc.LOCTYP_0    AS [Type emplacement],      sto.LOC_0          AS Emplacement,      stl.NEWLTIDAT_0    AS [Date recontrôle],      stl.SHLDAT_0       AS [Date péremption],      sto.STA_0          AS Statut,      sto.QTYSTU_0       AS [Quantité US],      itm.STU_0          AS [Unité stock]  FROM STOCK sto  INNER JOIN STOLOT stl      ON stl.ITMREF_0 = sto.ITMREF_0     AND stl.LOT_0    = sto.LOT_0     AND stl.SLO_0    = sto.SLO_0  INNER JOIN ITMMASTER itm      ON stl.ITMREF_0 = itm.ITMREF_0  INNER JOIN STOLOC stoloc      ON sto.LOC_0 = stoloc.LOC_0  WHERE       stl.SHLDAT_0 > '1900-01-01'      AND stl.SHLDAT_0 <= %1%      AND (stoloc.LOCTYP_0 = %2% OR %2% = '')  ORDER BY       stoloc.LOCTYP_0,      stl.ITMREF_0,      stl.LOT_0,      stl.SLO_0;

sql: SELECT       xrh.XITMREF_0,      itm.ITMDES1_0,      itm.TCLCOD_0,      xrh.XLOT_0,      xrh.XVALDAT_0,      xrh.XSTAFORCE_0,      xrh.XCOMMENT_0,      SUM(CASE WHEN xrh.XSTAFORCE_0 = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NB_STATUT_2,      SUM(CASE WHEN xrh.XSTAFORCE_0 = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NB_STATUT_3,      SUM(CASE WHEN xrh.XSTAFORCE_0 = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NB_STATUT_5  FROM XREQUESTH xrh  INNER JOIN ITMMASTER itm       ON itm.ITMREF_0 = xrh.XITMREF_0  WHERE      xrh.XVALDAT_0 BETWEEN %1% AND %2%  AND ( ISNULL(%3%, '') = '' OR itm.TCLCOD_0 = %3% )  GROUP BY       xrh.XITMREF_0,      itm.ITMDES1_0,      itm.TCLCOD_0,      xrh.XLOT_0,      xrh.XVALDAT_0,      xrh.XSTAFORCE_0,      xrh.XCOMMENT_0;

sql: SELECT DISTINCT      stolotProd.ITMREF_0,      itmmasterProd.ITMDES1_0 + itmmasterProd.ITMDES2_0,      stolotProd.LOT_0,      stolotProd.REFPER_0,        stolotComp.ITMREF_0,      itmmasterComp.ITMDES1_0 + itmmasterComp.ITMDES2_0,      stolotComp.LOT_0,      stolotComp.REFPER_0,        %1%,      %2%,      mfgitmtrk.MFGNUM_0  FROM STOLOT stolotProd  INNER JOIN ITMMASTER itmmasterProd      ON itmmasterProd.ITMREF_0 = stolotProd.ITMREF_0    INNER JOIN MFGITMTRK mfgitmtrk      ON mfgitmtrk.MFGTRKNUM_0 = stolotProd.VCRNUM_0    INNER JOIN MFGMAT mfgmat      ON mfgmat.MFGNUM_0 = mfgitmtrk.MFGNUM_0     AND mfgmat.LOT_0 <> ''     AND mfgmat.XCOMPO_0 = 2    INNER JOIN STOLOT stolotComp      ON stolotComp.LOT_0 = mfgmat.LOT_0    INNER JOIN ITMMASTER itmmasterComp      ON itmmasterComp.ITMREF_0 = stolotProd.ITMREF_0    WHERE stolotProd.REFPER_0 <> stolotComp.REFPER_0;

description: Requête importée automatiquement depuis l'export SQL Sage X3.
sql: SELECT       itm.ITMREF_0,      itm.ITMDES1_0,      itm.TCLCOD_0,      axx.TEXTE_0,      itm.CREDAT_0,      itm.TSICOD_0,      ax2.TEXTE_0,      MAX(itc.ITCENDDAT_0) AS DER_COUT_VALIDE  FROM ITMMASTER itm  LEFT OUTER JOIN ATEXTRA axx      ON axx.CODFIC_0 = 'ITMCATEG'     AND axx.LANGUE_0 = 'FRA'     AND axx.ZONE_0 = 'TCLAXX'     AND axx.IDENT1_0 = itm.TCLCOD_0  LEFT OUTER JOIN ATEXTRA ax2      ON ax2.CODFIC_0 = 'ATABDIV'     AND ax2.LANGUE_0 = 'FRA'     AND ax2.ZONE_0 = 'LNGDES'     AND ax2.IDENT1_0 = '20'     AND ax2.IDENT2_0 = itm.TSICOD_0  LEFT OUTER JOIN ITMCOST itc      ON itm.ITMREF_0 = itc.ITMREF_0     AND itc.CSTTYP_0 = 1  WHERE itm.STOMGTCOD_0 >= 2    AND NOT EXISTS (          SELECT 1          FROM ITMCOST itc2          WHERE itm.ITMREF_0 = itc2.ITMREF_0            AND itc2.CSTTYP_0 = 1            AND GETDATE() BETWEEN itc2.ITCSTRDAT_0 AND itc2.ITCENDDAT_0    )  GROUP BY       itm.ITMREF_0,      itm.ITMDES1_0,      itm.TCLCOD_0,      axx.TEXTE_0,      itm.CREDAT_0,      itm.TSICOD_0,      ax2.TEXTE_0;

sql: SELECT      SID.NUM_0    , SIV.BPAADD_0    , ISNULL(SIV.BPDADDLIG_0,'') + ' '       + ISNULL(SIV.BPDADDLIG_1,'') + ' '       + ISNULL(SIV.BPDADDLIG_2,'')    , SIV.BPDPOSCOD_0    , SIV.BPDCTY_0    , SIV.BPDCRY_0    , SIV.EECICT_0    , SIV.ICTCTY_0    , CASE           WHEN SID.SOHNUM_0 IS NOT NULL           THEN SID.SOHNUM_0           ELSE SIV.INVREF_0       END    , SID.SOPLIN_0    , SOH.CUSORDREF_0    , SIH.BPR_0    , SIH.BPRNAM_0    , SID.ITMREF_0    , SID.ITMDES1_0  FROM SINVOICED SID  INNER JOIN SINVOICE SIH      ON SIH.NUM_0 = SID.NUM_0  INNER JOIN SINVOICEV SIV      ON SIV.NUM_0 = SID.NUM_0  LEFT JOIN BPADDRESS BPA      ON SIV.BPAADD_0 = BPA.BPANUM_0  LEFT JOIN SORDER SOH      ON SOH.SOHNUM_0 = SID.SOHNUM_0  WHERE      (%1% = '' OR SID.NUM_0 BETWEEN %1% AND %2%)  AND (%3% = '' OR SID.SOHNUM_0 BETWEEN %3% AND %4%)  AND (%5% = '' OR SOH.CUSORDREF_0 BETWEEN %5% AND %6%)  AND (%7% = '' OR SIH.BPR_0 BETWEEN %7% AND %8%)  AND (%9% = '' OR SID.ITMREF_0 BETWEEN %9% AND %10%)

title: Valorisation des stocks

sql: select distinct           itc.STOFCY_0 as 'Site'         ,itc.CSTTYP_0 as 'Std'      ,itm.TCLCOD_0 as 'Catégorie'   ,itm.ITMREF_0 'Article'   ,itm.ITMDES1_0 as 'Description'   ,fam.TEXTE_0 as 'Famille'   ,form.TEXTE_0 as 'Forme'   ,dos.TEXTE_0 'Dosage'   ,tar.TEXTE_0 as 'Fam. Tar.'   ,itm.STU_0 as 'Unité'   /* ,case isnumeric(sum(stk.QTYSTU_0))        when 1 then convert(dec(20,4),sum(stk.QTYSTU_0)) else 0               end as 'Qty'  */         ,case            when %7% = 1 then (select sum(QTYSTU_0)                                  from STOCK                                  where ITMREF_0 = itm.ITMREF_0                                  and LOT_0 = stk.LOT_0                                  and STA_0 = stk.STA_0                                   and XFAVFLG_0 = ''                              group by ITMREF_0)            when %7% <> 1 then (select sum(QTYSTU_0)                                   from STOCK                                   where ITMREF_0 = itm.ITMREF_0                                    and LOT_0 = stk.LOT_0                                   and STA_0 = stk.STA_0  /*                                 and XFAVFLG_0 = ''  */                              group by ITMREF_0)          end as 'Qty'   ,stk.LOT_0 as 'Lot'   ,stk.STA_0 as 'Statut'         ,itc.FIYNUM_0 as 'Ex.'   ,(select max(seq.ITCSEQ_0) from ITMCOST seq                                                  where seq.ITMREF_0 = itc.ITMREF_0                                                    and seq.FIYNUM_0 = itc.FIYNUM_0                                                    and seq.CSTTYP_0 = 1                       ) as 'Séq.'    ,case isnumeric(itc.VLTTOT_0)       when 1 then convert(dec(16,4),itc.VLTTOT_0) else 0               end as 'Standard'   ,case isnumeric(slf.AVC_0)       when 1 then convert(dec(16,4),slf.AVC_0) else 0               end as 'PmP Lot Unit'         ,case isnumeric(((case            when %7% = 1 then (select sum(QTYSTU_0)                                  from STOCK                                  where ITMREF_0 = itm.ITMREF_0                                  and LOT_0 = stk.LOT_0                                  and STA_0 = stk.STA_0                                   and XFAVFLG_0 = ''                              group by ITMREF_0)            when %7% <> 1 then (select sum(QTYSTU_0)                                   from STOCK                                   where ITMREF_0 = itm.ITMREF_0                                    and LOT_0 = stk.LOT_0                                   and STA_0 = stk.STA_0  /*                                 and XFAVFLG_0 = ''  */                              group by ITMREF_0)          end) * itc.VLTTOT_0))             when 1 then convert(dec(20,6),((case            when %7% = 1 then (select sum(QTYSTU_0)                                  from STOCK                                  where ITMREF_0 = itm.ITMREF_0                                  and LOT_0 = stk.LOT_0                                  and STA_0 = stk.STA_0                                   and XFAVFLG_0 = ''                              group by ITMREF_0)            when %7% <> 1 then (select sum(QTYSTU_0)                                   from STOCK                                   where ITMREF_0 = itm.ITMREF_0                                    and LOT_0 = stk.LOT_0                                   and STA_0 = stk.STA_0  /*                                 and XFAVFLG_0 = ''  */                              group by ITMREF_0)          end) * itc.VLTTOT_0))                    else 0               end as 'Valor. Standard'         ,case isnumeric(((case            when %7% = 1 then (select sum(QTYSTU_0)                                  from STOCK                                  where ITMREF_0 = itm.ITMREF_0                                  and LOT_0 = stk.LOT_0                                  and STA_0 = stk.STA_0                                   and XFAVFLG_0 = ''                              group by ITMREF_0)            when %7% <> 1 then (select sum(QTYSTU_0)                                   from STOCK                                   where ITMREF_0 = itm.ITMREF_0                                    and LOT_0 = stk.LOT_0                                   and STA_0 = stk.STA_0  /*                                 and XFAVFLG_0 = ''  */                              group by ITMREF_0)          end) * slf.AVC_0))             when 1 then convert(dec(20,6),((case            when %7% = 1 then (select sum(QTYSTU_0)                                  from STOCK                                  where ITMREF_0 = itm.ITMREF_0                                  and LOT_0 = stk.LOT_0                                  and STA_0 = stk.STA_0                                   and XFAVFLG_0 = ''                              group by ITMREF_0)            when %7% <> 1 then (select sum(QTYSTU_0)                                   from STOCK                                   where ITMREF_0 = itm.ITMREF_0                                    and LOT_0 = stk.LOT_0                                   and STA_0 = stk.STA_0  /*                                 and XFAVFLG_0 = ''  */                              group by ITMREF_0)          end) * slf.AVC_0))             else 0               end as 'Valor. PmP Lot Unit'     from       ITMCOST itc   inner join ITMMASTER itm on itc.ITMREF_0 = itm.ITMREF_0  inner join STOCK stk on stk.STOFCY_0 = itc.STOFCY_0                       and stk.ITMREF_0 = itc.ITMREF_0     /*                    and stk.STA_0 <> 'A' */      left join STOLOTFCY slf on stk.STOFCY_0 = slf.STOFCY_0 and stk.ITMREF_0 = slf.ITMREF_0                          and stk.LOT_0 = slf.LOT_0 and stk.SLO_0 = slf.SLO_0      left join ATEXTRA fam on itm.TSICOD_1 <> ''                        and itm.TSICOD_1 = fam.IDENT2_0                        and fam.CODFIC_0 = 'ATABDIV' and fam.ZONE_0 = 'LNGDES'                        and fam.LANGUE_0 = 'FRA' and fam.IDENT1_0 = 21    left join ATEXTRA form on itm.TSICOD_2 <> ''                         and itm.TSICOD_2 = form.IDENT2_0                         and form.CODFIC_0 = 'ATABDIV' and form.ZONE_0 = 'LNGDES'                         and form.LANGUE_0 = 'FRA' and form.IDENT1_0 = 22    left join ATEXTRA dos on itm.TSICOD_4 <> ''                        and itm.TSICOD_4 = dos.IDENT2_0                        and dos.CODFIC_0 = 'ATABDIV' and dos.ZONE_0 = 'LNGDES'                        and dos.LANGUE_0 = 'FRA' and dos.IDENT1_0 = 24    left join ATEXTRA tar on itm.XFAMTAR_0 <> ''                        and itm.XFAMTAR_0 = tar.IDENT2_0                        and tar.CODFIC_0 = 'ATABDIV' and tar.ZONE_0 = 'LNGDES'                        and tar.LANGUE_0 = 'FRA' and tar.IDENT1_0 = 1008    where itc.STOFCY_0 = 'VDP1F'      and itc.CSTTYP_0 = %8%     and ((%1% = '' and %2% = '') or (itc.ITMREF_0 >= %1% and itc.ITMREF_0 <= %2%))     and (%3% = '' or itm.TSICOD_1 = %3%)       and ((%4% = '' and %5% = '') or (itm.TCLCOD_0 >= %4% and itm.TCLCOD_0 <= %5%))     and itc.FIYNUM_0 = %6%     and itc.ITCSEQ_0 = (select max(seq.ITCSEQ_0) from ITMCOST seq                                                  where seq.ITMREF_0 = itc.ITMREF_0                                                    and seq.FIYNUM_0 = itc.FIYNUM_0                                                    and seq.CSTTYP_0 = 1                       )      group by    itc.STOFCY_0       ,itc.CSTTYP_0         ,itm.TCLCOD_0        ,itm.ITMREF_0         ,itm.ITMDES1_0        ,fam.TEXTE_0        ,form.TEXTE_0       ,dos.TEXTE_0               ,tar.TEXTE_0                 ,itm.STU_0         ,stk.LOT_0        ,stk.STA_0             ,itc.FIYNUM_0       ,itc.ITMREF_0         ,itc.ITCSEQ_0         ,itc.VLTTOT_0       ,slf.AVC_0

ip.TCLCOD_0      AS categorie_parent,      ip.TSICOD_0      AS classe_article_parent,        b.BOMALT_0       AS alternative,      b.BOMSEQ_0       AS sequence,      b.LIKQTY_0       AS quantite_bom,      b.BOMUOM_0       AS unite_bom,        itf.OFS_0        AS delai_reappro_composant,        ic.SHL_0         AS peremption_composant,      ic.SHLLTIUOM_0   AS unite_peremption_composant,        cst.CSTTOT_0     AS cout_standard,      ic.STU_0         AS unite_stock_cout,        mvt.LASPURPRI_0  AS prix,      ic.PUU_0         AS unite_commande,      (mvt.LASPURPRI_0 * ic.PUUSTUCOE_0) AS prix_unit_HA    FROM BOMD b  INNER JOIN BOM bm           ON b.ITMREF_0 = bm.ITMREF_0         AND b.BOMALT_0 = bm.BOMALT_0         AND bm.USESTA_0 = '2'         AND bm.XCOMPLET_0 = '2'    INNER JOIN ITMMASTER ip ON ip.ITMREF_0 = b.ITMREF_0  INNER JOIN ITMMASTER ic ON ic.ITMREF_0 = b.CPNITMREF_0  INNER JOIN ITMFACILIT itf ON itf.ITMREF_0 = ic.ITMREF_0    LEFT JOIN ITMBPS ifr ON ifr.ITMREF_0 = b.CPNITMREF_0  LEFT JOIN BPSUPPLIER frs ON frs.BPSNUM_0 = ifr.BPSNUM_0  LEFT JOIN BPADDRESS adr ON adr.BPANUM_0 = frs.BPSNUM_0 AND adr.BPAADDFLG_0 = 2    LEFT JOIN BPARTNER FAB1 ON FAB1.BPRNUM_0 = ifr.XFABRIQUANT_0  LEFT JOIN BPADDRESS ADD1 ON ADD1.BPANUM_0 = FAB1.BPRNUM_0 AND ADD1.BPAADD_0 = FAB1.BPAADD_0    LEFT JOIN BPARTNER FAB2 ON FAB2.BPRNUM_0 = ifr.YFABRIQUAN1_0  LEFT JOIN BPADDRESS ADD2 ON ADD2.BPANUM_0 = FAB2.BPRNUM_0 AND ADD2.BPAADD_0 = FAB2.BPAADD_0    LEFT JOIN BPARTNER FAB3 ON FAB3.BPRNUM_0 = ifr.YFABRIQUAN2_0  LEFT JOIN BPADDRESS ADD3 ON ADD3.BPANUM_0 = FAB3.BPRNUM_0 AND ADD3.BPAADD_0 = FAB3.BPAADD_0    LEFT JOIN ITMCOST cst          ON cst.ITMREF_0 = b.CPNITMREF_0        AND cst.CSTTYP_0 = 1        AND GETDATE() BETWEEN cst.ITCSTRDAT_0 AND cst.ITCENDDAT_0    LEFT JOIN ITMMVT mvt ON mvt.ITMREF_0 = b.CPNITMREF_0    WHERE b.BOMALT_0 BETWEEN %8% AND %9%    AND (ip.ITMREF_0 = %1% OR %1% = '')    AND (ip.TCLCOD_0 = %2% OR %2% = '')    AND (ip.TSICOD_0 = %3% OR %3% = '')    AND (ic.ITMREF_0 = %4% OR %4% = '')    AND (ic.TCLCOD_0 = %5% OR %5% = '')    AND (ic.TSICOD_0 = %6% OR %6% = '')    AND (frs.BPSNUM_0 = %7% OR %7% = '')    ORDER BY 1, 5, 6;

title: Extraction Prev Conso

sql: SELECT *  FROM (  SELECT orders.ITMREF_0 [CODE_ART]     , itmmaster.ITMDES1_0 [DES_ART]     , itmmaster.YACTCOD_0 [BUS]     , isnull(atextra_Fam.TEXTE_0,'') as [FAM]     , isnull(atextra_Cli.TEXTE_0,'') as [CLI]     , itmmaster.STU_0 [STU]     , itmsales.BASPRI_0 [PRI]     , Year(orders.STRDAT_0) [YEAR]     , DATENAME(MONTH, orders.STRDAT_0) [MONTH]     , orders.EXTQTY_0 [QTY]        FROM ORDERS orders    inner join ITMMASTER itmmaster on itmmaster.ITMREF_0=orders.ITMREF_0    left join ITMSALES itmsales on itmsales.ITMREF_0=orders.ITMREF_0    left join ATEXTRA atextra_Fam on atextra_Fam.CODFIC_0 = 'ATABDIV' and atextra_Fam.ZONE_0='LNGDES' and atextra_Fam.LANGUE_0='FRA' and atextra_Fam.IDENT1_0='22' and atextra_Fam.IDENT2_0=itmmaster.TSICOD_2    left join ATEXTRA atextra_Cli on atextra_Cli.CODFIC_0 = 'ATABDIV' and atextra_Cli.ZONE_0='LNGDES' and atextra_Cli.LANGUE_0='FRA' and atextra_Cli.IDENT1_0='23' and atextra_Cli.IDENT2_0=itmmaster.TSICOD_3    where orders.WIPTYP_0 = 1 and orders.WIPSTA_0 = 3  and ((orders.ITMREF_0 between %1% and %2%) or %2%='')  and (YEAR(orders.STRDAT_0) = %3% or %3%='')  and (itmmaster.YACTCOD_0 = %4% or %4%='')  and (atextra_Fam.TEXTE_0 = %5% or %5%='')  and (atextra_Cli.TEXTE_0 = %6% or %6%='')  ) AS MonthlyForecastData  PIVOT( SUM([QTY])      FOR MONTH IN ([January],[February],[March],[April],[May],      [June],[July],[August],[September],[October],[November],      [December])) AS ForecastPivot

title: AQ - Lead time Récept-Valorisa
description: Requête importée automatiquement depuis l'export SQL Sage X3.
sql: SELECT       ptd.RCPDAT_0,      ptd.ITMREF_0,      itm.ITMDES1_0,      ptd.QTYUOM_0,      ptd.UOM_0,      itm.TCLCOD_0,      xrh.XLOT_0,      stl.BPSLOT_0,      xrh.XSTAFORCE_0,      MAX(xrh.XVALDAT_0) AS XVALDAT_MAX,      DATEDIFF(          DAY,          ptd.RCPDAT_0,          MAX(xrh.XVALDAT_0)      ) AS NbJour  FROM PRECEIPTD ptd  INNER JOIN ITMMASTER itm       ON itm.ITMREF_0 = ptd.ITMREF_0  INNER JOIN XREQUESTH xrh       ON xrh.XVCRNUMORI_0 = ptd.PTHNUM_0     AND xrh.XVCRLINORI_0 = ptd.PTDLIN_0     AND xrh.XTRANSAC_0 = 1     AND xrh.XVALDAT_0 BETWEEN %1% AND %2%  INNER JOIN STOLOT stl       ON stl.ITMREF_0 = xrh.XITMREF_0     AND stl.LOT_0 = xrh.XLOT_0  WHERE      (%3% = '' OR itm.TCLCOD_0 = %3%)  GROUP BY       ptd.RCPDAT_0,      ptd.ITMREF_0,      itm.ITMDES1_0,      itm.TCLCOD_0,      xrh.XLOT_0,      stl.BPSLOT_0,      ptd.QTYUOM_0,      ptd.UOM_0,      xrh.XSTAFORCE_0;

title: Droits sur RIB
description: Requête importée automatiquement depuis l'export SQL Sage X3.
sql: # Liste des utilisateurs ayant le droit de modifier la fiche fournisseur dont le RIB avec fonction et accés.    select aut.NOMUSR_0 as 'Nom Utilisateur'          ,aut.USR_0 as 'Trigramme'            ,case            when aut.ENAFLG_0 <> 2 then 'Inactif'            else 'Actif'          end as 'Statut'            ,aft.PRFCOD_0 as 'Code Profil'         ,afc.ALLFCT_0 as 'Toutes fonctions'                ,aft.FNC_0 as 'Fonction'         ,aft.ACS_0 as 'Droit'         ,aft.OPT_0 as 'Option'         ,afc.ALLACS_0 as 'Tout accés'         ,acc.CODACC_0 as 'Code d acces'         ,acc.CONSUL_0 as 'Consultation'         ,acc.EXEC_0 as 'Exécution'         ,acc.MODIF_0 as 'Modification'           from AUTILIS aut  join AFCTFCT afc on afc.PRFCOD_0 = aut.PRFFCT_0  left join AFCTPRF aft on aft.PRFCOD_0 = afc.PRFCOD_0  left join ACCES acc on acc.PRFCOD_0 = aft.PRFCOD_0    where  (aut.ENAFLG_0 = 2              /* Pour les profils actifs              */         and aft.FNC_0 = 'GESBPS'      /* Avec fonction accès aux fournisseurs */         and aft.ACS_0 = 2             /* Doit avoir accès à la fonction       */         and aft.OPT_0 <> ' '          /* Doit avoir des droits sur la fonction*/         and (acc.CODACC_0 = 'MODIFBPS' or acc.CODACC_0 = 'MODIFBPSS')         and aut.USR_0 <> 'VMI'  /* Exclusion du profil interface VMI */)  or          (afc.ALLFCT_0 = '2'        /* Pour les profils toutes fonctions   */           and aut.ENAFLG_0 = 2       /* pour les profils actifs */                      and aut.USR_0 <> 'BATCH'           and aut.USR_0 <> 'ADMIN' )       order by   aft.PRFCOD_0            ,aut.NOMUSR_0

sql: # Liste des utilisateurs avec des droits sur les articles    select aut.NOMUSR_0 as 'Nom Utilisateur'          ,aut.USR_0 as 'Trigramme'            ,case            when aut.ENAFLG_0 <> 2 then 'Inactif'            else 'Actif'          end as 'Statut'            ,aft.PRFCOD_0 as 'Code Profil'         ,afc.ALLFCT_0 as 'Toutes fonctions'                ,aft.FNC_0 as 'Fonction'         ,aft.ACS_0 as 'Droit'         ,aft.OPT_0 as 'Option'                  from AUTILIS aut  join AFCTFCT afc on afc.PRFCOD_0 = aut.PRFFCT_0  left join AFCTPRF aft on aft.PRFCOD_0 = afc.PRFCOD_0    where  ( aut.ENAFLG_0 = 2           /* Pour les profils actifs              */         and aft.FNC_0 = 'GESITM'   /* Avec fonction accès aux fournisseurs */         and aft.ACS_0 = 2          /* Doit avoir accès à la fonction       */         and aft.OPT_0 <> ' '       /* Doit avoir des droits sur la fonction*/         and aut.USR_0 <> 'VMI'     /* Exclusion du profil interface VMI    */         and aut.USR_0 <> 'Groupe%' /* Exclusion du profil interface VMI    */ )    or           (afc.ALLFCT_0 = '2'          /* Pour les profils toutes fonctions   */           and aut.ENAFLG_0 = 2        /* pour les profils actifs */                      and aut.USR_0 <> 'BATCH'           and aut.USR_0 <> 'ADMIN' )               order by   aft.PRFCOD_0            ,aut.NOMUSR_0

sql: # Liste des utilisateurs avec une fonction spécifique en variable et des droits autres que consultation avec le type de droits sur la fonction.    select aut.NOMUSR_0 as 'Nom Utilisateur'          ,aut.USR_0 as 'Trigramme'            ,case            when aut.ENAFLG_0 <> 2 then 'Inactif'            else 'Actif'          end as 'Statut'            ,aft.PRFCOD_0 as 'Code Profil'         ,afc.ALLACS_0 as 'Tout accés'         ,afc.ALLFCT_0 as 'Toutes fonctions'         ,aft.FNC_0 as 'Fonction'         ,aft.ACS_0 as 'Droit'         ,aft.OPT_0 as 'Option'                  from AUTILIS aut  join AFCTFCT afc on afc.PRFCOD_0 = aut.PRFFCT_0  left join AFCTPRF aft on aft.PRFCOD_0 = afc.PRFCOD_0    where  (aut.ENAFLG_0 = 2          /* Pour les profils actifs              */         and aft.FNC_0 = %1%        /* Avec fonction accès aux fournisseurs */         and aft.ACS_0 = 2          /* Doit avoir accès à la fonction       */         and aft.OPT_0 <> ' '       /* Doit avoir des droits sur la fonction*/          and aft.PRFCOD_0 = %2% )  or          (afc.ALLFCT_0 = '2'        /* Pour les profils toutes fonctions   */           and aut.ENAFLG_0 = 2     /* pour les profils actifs */                      and aut.USR_0 <> 'BATCH'           and aut.USR_0 <> 'ADMIN' )                                                                                                                                                                        order by   aut.NOMUSR_0

,aft.FNC_0 as 'Fonction'           ,case            when aft.ACS_0 = '2'  then 'Oui'            when aft.ACS_0 = '1'  then 'Non'           else 'NA'          end as 'Droit'                  ,aft.OPT_0 as 'Option'         ,afc.ALLACS_0 as 'Tout accés'         ,acc.CODACC_0 as 'Code d accés'         ,acc.CONSUL_0 as 'Consultation'         ,acc.EXEC_0 as 'Exécution'         ,acc.MODIF_0 as 'Modification'           from AUTILIS aut  join AFCTFCT afc on afc.PRFCOD_0 = aut.PRFFCT_0  left join AFCTPRF aft on aft.PRFCOD_0 = afc.PRFCOD_0  left join ACCES acc on acc.PRFCOD_0 = aft.PRFCOD_0    where  (aut.ENAFLG_0 = 2              /* Pour les profils actifs               */         and aft.FNC_0 = 'GESXQP'       /* Avec fonction accès QC Orders         */         /* and aft.FNC_0 = 'CONSXQR'      Avec fonction accès Poste de charge   */         /* and aft.FNC_0 = 'CONSXQP'      Avec fonction accès Lot de controle   */         and aft.ACS_0 = 2              /* Doit avoir accès à la fonction        */         and acc.CODACC_0 = 'XQUALSTA'  /* Doit avoir accés zone Statut de stock */                    and acc.MODIF_0 = '2' )     or           (aut.ENAFLG_0 = 2              /* Pour les profils actifs              */         and aft.FNC_0 = 'GESSCS'       /* Avec fonction accès aux fournisseurs */         and aft.ACS_0 = 2             /* Doit avoir accès à la fonction       */         and aft.OPT_0 <> ' '          /* Doit avoir des droits sur la fonction*/         and (acc.CODACC_0 = 'AQ'            or acc.CODACC_0 = 'CQ'            or acc.CODACC_0 = 'DES01'            or acc.CODACC_0 = 'MODIFITM'            or acc.CODACC_0 = 'QUA'            or acc.CODACC_0 = 'REJECT'             or acc.CODACC_0 = 'RELEASE'            or acc.CODACC_0 = 'SCORET'             or acc.CODACC_0 = 'XAQVALPF'            or acc.CODACC_0 = 'XQCCTLSAI'            or acc.CODACC_0 = 'XQCRESPQ'            or acc.CODACC_0 = 'YPROFILHA'            or acc.CODACC_0 = 'YPROTRN'))    or           ( afc.ALLFCT_0 = '2'       /* Pour les profils toutes fonctions   */           and aut.ENAFLG_0 = 2      /* pour les profils actifs */                      and aut.USR_0 <> 'VMI'          and aut.USR_0 <> 'BATCH'           and aut.USR_0 <> 'ADMIN' )          order by   aft.PRFCOD_0            ,aut.NOMUSR_0

sql: SELECT SOP.SOHNUM_0 as 'N° Commande'   ,SOH.ORDDAT_0 as 'Date commande'   ,SOP.SOPLIN_0 as 'Ligne'   ,SOP.SOQSTA_0 as 'Etat ligne'   ,SOH.CUSORDREF_0 as 'Référence commande client'   ,SOH.BPCORD_0 as 'Code client'   ,SOH.BPCNAM_0 as 'Raison sociale'   ,SOQ.DEMDLVDAT_0 as 'Date liv demandée'   ,SOQ.SHIDAT_0 as 'Date expédition'   ,ITM.TCLCOD_0 as 'Catégorie article'   ,SOP.ITMREF_0 as 'Code article'   ,SOP.ITMDES1_0 as 'Désignation article'   ,SOQ.QTY_0 as 'Qté cdée'   ,SOP.SAU_0 as 'Unité'   ,SOQ.ALLQTY_0 as 'Qté allouée'   ,SOQ.DLVQTY_0 as 'Qté livrée'   ,SOQ.INVQTY_0 as 'Qté facturée'   ,SOP.NETPRINOT_0 as 'Prix net HT'   ,SOH.CUR_0 as 'Devise'   ,SOP.NETPRINOT_0*SOQ.QTY_0 as 'Mt ligne HT'   ,SOP.NETPRIATI_0*SOQ.QTY_0 as 'Mt ligne TTC'   ,SOQ.SOHCAT_0 as 'Catégorie commande'   ,SOQ.XBPCLOT_0 as 'Extern batch number'    FROM SORDERP SOP   INNER JOIN SORDER SOH    ON SOH.SOHNUM_0 = SOP.SOHNUM_0   INNER JOIN SORDERQ SOQ    ON SOQ.SOHNUM_0 = SOP.SOHNUM_0    AND SOQ.SOPLIN_0 = SOP.SOPLIN_0   INNER JOIN ITMMASTER ITM    ON ITM.ITMREF_0 = SOP.ITMREF_0   INNER JOIN BPCUSTOMER BPC    ON BPC.BPCNUM_0 = SOP.BPCORD_0    WHERE ((%1% = '' and %2% = '') or (SOP.ITMREF_0 >= %1% and SOP.ITMREF_0 <= %2%))   AND ((%3% = '' and %4% = '') or (SOH.BPCORD_0 >= %3% and SOH.BPCORD_0 <= %4%))   AND ((%5% = '' and %6% = '') or (SOP.SOHNUM_0 >= %5% and SOP.SOHNUM_0 <= %6%))   AND (SOH.ORDDAT_0 BETWEEN %7% and %8%)   AND ((%9% = '' and %10% = '') or (SOP.SOQSTA_0 >= %9% and SOP.SOQSTA_0 <= %10%))   AND ((%11%= '' and %12% = '') or (ITM.YACTCOD_0 >= %11% and ITM.YACTCOD_0 <= %12%))

sql: SELECT        itf.BUY_0,      aus.NOMUSR_0,      itm.ITMREF_0,      itm.ITMDES1_0,      itm.TCLCOD_0,      axx.TEXTE_0,      itm.CREDAT_0,      itm.TSICOD_0,      ax2.TEXTE_0,      itm.STU_0,      itm.PUU_0,      itm.PUUSTUCOE_0,      (itv.PHYSTO_0 + itv.CTLSTO_0 + itv.REJSTO_0) AS QTESTO,      itv.LASPURDAT_0,      REPLACE(CAST(CAST(pop.NETPRI_0 AS DECIMAL(12,4)) AS VARCHAR(15)),'.',',') AS NETPRI,      itv.LASRCPDAT_0,      itv.LASRCPPRI_0,      itv.VCRNUM_0,      prd.BPSNUM_0,      bps.BPSNAM_0,      prd.POHNUM_0,      MAX(itc.ITCENDDAT_0) AS DER_COUT_EXISTANT  FROM ITMMASTER itm  LEFT JOIN ATEXTRA axx          ON axx.CODFIC_0 = 'ITMCATEG'        AND axx.LANGUE_0 = 'FRA'        AND axx.ZONE_0   = 'TCLAXX'        AND axx.IDENT1_0 = itm.TCLCOD_0  LEFT JOIN ATEXTRA ax2          ON ax2.CODFIC_0 = 'ATABDIV'        AND ax2.LANGUE_0 = 'FRA'        AND ax2.ZONE_0   = 'LNGDES'        AND ax2.IDENT1_0 = '20'        AND ax2.IDENT2_0 = itm.TSICOD_0  LEFT JOIN ITMCOST itc          ON itc.ITMREF_0 = itm.ITMREF_0        AND itc.CSTTYP_0 = 1  LEFT JOIN ITMMVT itv          ON itv.ITMREF_0 = itm.ITMREF_0        AND itv.STOFCY_0 = 'VDP1F'  LEFT JOIN PRECEIPTD prd          ON prd.PTHNUM_0 = itv.VCRNUM_0        AND prd.PTDLIN_0 = itv.VCRLIN_0  LEFT JOIN PORDERP pop          ON pop.POHNUM_0 = prd.POHNUM_0        AND pop.POPLIN_0 = prd.POPLIN_0        AND pop.POPSEQ_0 = prd.POQSEQ_0  LEFT JOIN BPSUPPLIER bps          ON bps.BPSNUM_0 = prd.BPSNUM_0  INNER JOIN ITMFACILIT itf          ON itf.ITMREF_0 = itm.ITMREF_0        AND itf.STOFCY_0 = 'VDP1F'  LEFT JOIN AUTILIS aus          ON aus.USR_0 = itf.BUY_0  WHERE itm.STOMGTCOD_0 >= 2    AND itf.VLTCOD_0 <> 'NVL'    AND (%1% = '' OR itf.BUY_0 = %1%)    AND NOT EXISTS (          SELECT 1          FROM ITMCOST itc2          WHERE itc2.ITMREF_0 = itm.ITMREF_0            AND itc2.CSTTYP_0 = 1            AND itc2.VLTTOT_0 <> 0            AND GETDATE() BETWEEN itc2.ITCSTRDAT_0 AND itc2.ITCENDDAT_0    )  GROUP BY       itf.BUY_0,      aus.NOMUSR_0,      itm.ITMREF_0,      itm.ITMDES1_0,      itm.TCLCOD_0,      axx.TEXTE_0,      itm.CREDAT_0,      itm.TSICOD_0,      ax2.TEXTE_0,      itm.STU_0,      itm.PUU_0,      itm.PUUSTUCOE_0,      (itv.PHYSTO_0 + itv.CTLSTO_0 + itv.REJSTO_0),      itv.LASPURDAT_0,      pop.NETPRI_0,      itv.LASRCPDAT_0,      itv.LASRCPPRI_0,      itv.VCRNUM_0,      prd.BPSNUM_0,      bps.BPSNAM_0,      prd.POHNUM_0;

sql: SELECT       stl.REFPER_0,      stl.ITMREF_0,      itm.ITMDES1_0,      itm.TCLCOD_0,      xrh.XLOT_0,      MAX(xrh.XVALDAT_0) AS XVALDAT_MAX,      mfg.CPLQTY_0,      mfg.STU_0,      CONVERT(          NVARCHAR(250),          (              SELECT                   xrh2.XREQNUM_0 + '(' +                  CASE                       WHEN apl.LANMES_0 = '' THEN 'En attente'                      ELSE apl.LANMES_0                  END + ')#'              FROM XREQUESTH xrh2              INNER JOIN APLSTD apl                   ON apl.LANNUM_0 = xrh2.XSTAFORCE_0                 AND apl.LANCHP_0 = 1009                 AND apl.LAN_0 = 'FRA'              WHERE xrh2.XITMREF_0 = stl.ITMREF_0                AND xrh2.XLOT_0 = stl.LOT_0              ORDER BY xrh2.XREQNUM_0              FOR XML PATH('')          )      ) AS QCORDERINFO,      DATEDIFF(          DAY,          stl.REFPER_0,          MAX(xrh.XVALDAT_0)      ) AS NbJour  FROM STOLOT stl  INNER JOIN ITMMASTER itm       ON itm.ITMREF_0 = stl.ITMREF_0  INNER JOIN XREQUESTH xrh       ON xrh.XITMREF_0 = stl.ITMREF_0     AND xrh.XLOT_0 = stl.LOT_0     AND xrh.XTRANSAC_0 IN (2,3)     AND xrh.XVALDAT_0 BETWEEN %1% AND %2%  LEFT JOIN MFGITM mfg       ON mfg.ITMREF_0 = stl.ITMREF_0     AND mfg.LOT_0 = stl.LOT_0  WHERE     (itm.TCLCOD_0 = %3% or %3% = '')    GROUP BY stl.REFPER_0,stl.ITMREF_0,itm.ITMDES1_0,itm.TCLCOD_0,xrh.XLOT_0, mfg.CPLQTY_0, stl.LOT_0, mfg.STU_0

title: AQ - Lead time Decl.-Valorisa
description: Requête importée automatiquement depuis l'export SQL Sage X3.
sql: SELECT       mfi.TRKLAST_0,      stl.REFPER_0,      mfi.ITMREF_0,      itm.ITMDES1_0,      itm.TCLCOD_0,      xrh.XLOT_0,      mfi.CPLQTY_0,      mfi.STU_0,      CONVERT(          NVARCHAR(250),          (              SELECT                   xrh2.XREQNUM_0 + '(' +                  ISNULL(apl.LANMES_0, 'En attente') + ')#'              FROM XREQUESTH xrh2              INNER JOIN APLSTD apl                   ON apl.LANNUM_0 = xrh2.XTRANSAC_0                 AND apl.LANCHP_0 = 1009                 AND apl.LAN_0 = 'FRA'              WHERE xrh2.XITMREF_0 = mfi.ITMREF_0                AND xrh2.XLOT_0 = xrh.XLOT_0              ORDER BY xrh2.XREQNUM_0              FOR XML PATH('')          )      ) AS QCORDERINFO,      MAX(xrh.XVALDAT_0) AS XVALDAT_MAX,      DATEDIFF(          DAY,          mfi.TRKLAST_0,          MAX(xrh.XVALDAT_0)      ) AS NbJour  FROM MFGITM mfi  INNER JOIN ITMMASTER itm       ON itm.ITMREF_0 = mfi.ITMREF_0  INNER JOIN XREQUESTH xrh       ON xrh.XITMREF_0 = mfi.ITMREF_0     AND xrh.XLOT_0 = mfi.LOT_0     AND xrh.XTRANSAC_0 IN (2,3)     AND xrh.XVALDAT_0 BETWEEN %1% AND %2%  INNER JOIN STOLOT stl       ON stl.LOT_0 = xrh.XLOT_0  WHERE      ( ISNULL(%3%, '') = '' OR itm.TCLCOD_0 = %3% )  GROUP BY       mfi.TRKLAST_0,      stl.REFPER_0,      mfi.ITMREF_0,      itm.ITMDES1_0,      itm.TCLCOD_0,      xrh.XLOT_0,      mfi.CPLQTY_0,      mfi.STU_0;

title: ACH1 - Comm. en cours (Qty 0)
description: Requête importée automatiquement depuis l'export SQL Sage X3.
sql: # Ticket GLPI 6761 (base X262)   # Requête SQL afin d'exporter les Commandes en cours avec Qty Reçue = 0 et date de   #             livraison demandée < ou = à date référence (Dt du jour)   # Ticket GLPI VDP 30212   #             Adaptation pour Valdepharm    select           poq.EXTRCPDAT_0 as 'Dt Liv Demandée'   ,poq.POHNUM_0 as 'N° Commande'   ,poh.XFCYADD_0 as 'Site de livraison'         ,poq.ITMREF_0 as 'Code Art'         ,itm.ITMDES1_0 as 'Désignation Art.'         ,poq.BPSNUM_0 as 'Code Frn'         ,bps.BPSNAM_0 as 'Nom Frn'         ,poq.QTYPUU_0 as 'Qté Cdée'         ,poq.RCPQTYPUU_0 as 'Qté Reçue'         ,(poq.QTYPUU_0-poq.RCPQTYPUU_0) as 'Qté Restante'   ,poq.PUU_0 as 'Unité'  from PORDERQ poq  inner join PORDER poh on poq.POHNUM_0 = poh.POHNUM_0  inner join BPSUPPLIER bps on poq.BPSNUM_0 = bps.BPSNUM_0  inner join ITMMASTER itm on poq.ITMREF_0 = itm.ITMREF_0  inner join ITMBPS itp on (poq.ITMREF_0 = itp.ITMREF_0 and poq.BPSNUM_0 = itp.BPSNUM_0)  inner join PORDERP pop on (poq.POHNUM_0 = pop.POHNUM_0 and poq.POPLIN_0 = pop.POPLIN_0                        and poq.POQSEQ_0 = pop.POPSEQ_0)  inner join XITMSTAT xis ON xis.ITMREF_0 = poq.ITMREF_0    where poq.LINCLEFLG_0 <> 2    and poq.RCPQTYPUU_0 <= ((poq.QTYPUU_0 * %3%)/100)    and (poq.EXTRCPDAT_0 <= %1% or %1% = '01-JAN-00')     and (poh.XFCYADD_0 = %2% or %2% = '')    order by poq.EXTRCPDAT_0

title: Products Catalogue
description: Requête importée automatiquement depuis l'export SQL Sage X3.
sql: # YAUD1 _ Product Catalogue  # Requête SQL pour trouver les articles du catalogue   # Date de référence pour le coût standard    SELECT   ITM.ITMREF_0,   AXX.TEXTE_0,  ITF.STOFCY_0,  ITM.TCLCOD_0,  ITF.ABCCLS_0,   ITF.SAFSTO_0,    ITV.PHYSTO_0,   ITV.CTLSTO_0 ,   ITV.REJSTO_0,   ITV.AVC_0  ,(   SELECT TOP 1  ITC.VLTTOT_0  FROM ITMCOST ITC  WHERE ITC.CSTTYP_0 = 1  AND ITC.ITMREF_0 = ITM.ITMREF_0  AND ITC.STOFCY_0 = %1%  ORDER BY ITC.ITCENDDAT_0 DESC  ) AS COUTSTD  ,(   SELECT TOP 1  ITC.CLCQTY_0  FROM ITMCOST ITC  WHERE ITC.CSTTYP_0 = 1  AND ITC.ITMREF_0 = ITM.ITMREF_0  AND ITC.STOFCY_0 = %1%  ORDER BY ITC.ITCENDDAT_0 DESC  ) AS QTECALCUL  ,(   SELECT TOP 1  ITC.ITCSTRDAT_0  FROM ITMCOST ITC  WHERE ITC.CSTTYP_0 = 1  AND ITC.ITMREF_0 = ITM.ITMREF_0  AND ITC.STOFCY_0 = %1%  ORDER BY ITC.ITCSTRDAT_0 DESC  ) AS DATEDEB  ,(   SELECT TOP 1  ITC.ITCENDDAT_0  FROM ITMCOST ITC  WHERE ITC.CSTTYP_0 = 1  AND ITC.ITMREF_0 = ITM.ITMREF_0  AND ITC.STOFCY_0 = %1%  ORDER BY ITC.ITCENDDAT_0 DESC  ) AS DATEFIN  FROM ITMMASTER ITM  LEFT OUTER JOIN ATEXTRA AXX ON (ITM.ITMREF_0 = AXX.IDENT1_0 and AXX.ZONE_0 = 'DES1AXX' and AXX.LANGUE_0 = %GLANGUE%)  JOIN ITMFACILIT ITF ON ITF.ITMREF_0 = ITM.ITMREF_0  JOIN ITMMVT ITV ON ITV.ITMREF_0 = ITF.ITMREF_0 AND ITV.STOFCY_0 = ITF.STOFCY_0  WHERE ITF.STOFCY_0 = %1%  AND ITM.ITMREF_0 >= %2%  AND (ITM.ITMREF_0 <= %3% OR RTRIM(%3%) IS NULL OR RTRIM(%3%)='')  AND ITM.TCLCOD_0 >= %4%  AND (ITM.TCLCOD_0 <= %5% OR RTRIM(%5%) IS NULL OR RTRIM(%5%)='')  ORDER BY ITM.ITMREF_0

sql: # Ticket GLPI 6267 (B. Fattal)  # Requête SQL : L’objectif de la requete est de reconstituer le stock projeté d’un  #               article. Le stock actuel est déjà disponible, il nous manque  #               l’extraction de tous les mouvements futurs de consommation (MWx / SOx)  #               et d’alimentation (POx / WOx) du stock  #    select    itm.TCLCOD_0 as 'Catégorie'           ,ord.ITMREF_0 as 'Article'           ,itm.ITMDES1_0 as 'Désignation'           ,itm.TSICOD_0 as 'Stat 1 Art'            ,a00.TEXTE_0 as ' '           ,itm.TSICOD_1 as 'Stat 2 Art'           ,a01.TEXTE_0 as ' '                     ,itm.TSICOD_2 as 'Stat 3 Art'            ,a02.TEXTE_0 as ' '           ,itm.TSICOD_3 as 'Stat 4 Art'            ,a03.TEXTE_0 as ' '           ,case              when ord.WIPSTA_0 = '1' then 'Ferme'              when ord.WIPSTA_0 = '2' then 'Planifié'              when ord.WIPSTA_0 = '3' then 'Suggéré'              when ord.WIPSTA_0 = '4' then 'Clos'            end as 'Statut En-cours'           ,ord.WIPTYP_0 as 'Type ordre'           ,ast1.LANMES_0 as 'Descript. Type Ordre'           ,case            when ISNULL(ord.STRDAT_0, '') = ''             then ' '             else case                  when ord.STRDAT_0 < '2000-01-01' then ' '                  else CONVERT(char(10), ord.STRDAT_0, 103)                  end            end as 'Date Début'          ,case            when ISNULL(ord.ENDDAT_0, '') = ''             then ' '             else case                  when ord.ENDDAT_0 < '2000-01-01' then ' '                  else CONVERT(char(10), ord.ENDDAT_0, 103)                  end            end as 'Date Fin'  /*        ,case            when ISNULL(ord.MRPDAT_0, '') = ''             then ' '             else case                  when ord.MRPDAT_0 < '2000-01-01' then ' '                  else CONVERT(char(10), ord.MRPDAT_0, 103)                  end            end as 'Date Dispo'  */          ,case             when ISNULL((select  min(ordw.ENDDAT_0)                                 from  ORDERS ordw                            where  ordw.ITMREF_0 = ord.ITMREF_0                              and  ordw.STOFCY_0 ='FAMB1'                              and  ordw.WIPSTA_0 <  4                              and  (ordw.WIPTYP_0 = 2)                        group by  ordw.ITMREF_0), '') = ''              then ' '              else case                     when (select  min(ordw.ENDDAT_0)                                 from  ORDERS ordw                            where  ordw.ITMREF_0 = ord.ITMREF_0                              and  ordw.STOFCY_0 ='FAMB1'                              and  ordw.WIPSTA_0 <  4                              and  (ordw.WIPTYP_0 = 2)                        group by  ordw.ITMREF_0) < '2000-01-01' then ' '                     else CONVERT(char(10), (select  min(ordw.ENDDAT_0)                                                   from  ORDERS ordw                                              where  ordw.ITMREF_0 = ord.ITMREF_0                                                and  ordw.STOFCY_0 ='FAMB1'                                                and  ordw.WIPSTA_0 <  4                                                and  (ordw.WIPTYP_0 = 2)                                          group by  ordw.ITMREF_0), 103)                     end             end as 'Date 1er Besoin'           ,ord.WIPNUM_0 as 'No ordre'           ,ord.VCRNUM_0 as 'Pièce'           ,ord.VCRNUMORI_0 as 'Pièce origine'           ,ord.EXTQTY_0 as 'Qty'           ,( select  sum(stj2.QTYSTU_0)                from  STOJOU stj2               where  stj2.STOFCY_0 = 'FAMB1'                 and  stj2.ITMREF_0 = ord.ITMREF_0                  and  stj2.LOT_0 = mfi.LOT_0                  and  stj2.TRSTYP_0 = 5                  and  stj2.STA_0 = 'Q'             group by   stj2.ITMREF_0                      ,stj2.LOT_0                      ,stj2.STA_0                      ,stj2.TRSTYP_0             ) as 'Qty déjà Déclarée'           ,ord.ITMREFORI_0 as 'Article Origine'                          from ORDERS ord              inner join ITMMASTER itm on itm.ITMREF_0 = ord.ITMREF_0       inner join XITMSTAT xis on xis.ITMREF_0 = itm.ITMREF_0   /* Ajout du 23 Novemebre 2017 demande B. Fattal */       left join MFGITM mfi on ord.VCRNUM_0 like 'OF%'                            and mfi.ITMREF_0 = ord.ITMREF_0                           and mfi.MFGNUM_0 = ord.VCRNUM_0   /* Fin Ajout */        left outer join APLSTD as ast1 on ast1.LANCHP_0 = '306'                                 and ast1.LAN_0 = 'FRA'                                 and ast1.LANNUM_0 = ord.WIPTYP_0       left join ATEXTRA a00 on itm.TSICOD_0 <> ''                             and itm.TSICOD_0 = a00.IDENT2_0                             and a00.CODFIC_0 = 'ATABDIV'                             and a00.ZONE_0 = 'LNGDES'                             and a00.LANGUE_0 = 'FRA'                             and a00.IDENT1_0 = 20        left join ATEXTRA a01 on itm.TSICOD_1 <> ''                             and                  and a03.LANGUE_0 = 'FRA'                             and a03.IDENT1_0 = 23       left join ATEXTRA a04 on itm.TSICOD_4 <> ''                             and itm.TSICOD_4 = a04.IDENT2_0                             and a04.CODFIC_0 = 'ATABDIV'                             and a04.ZONE_0 = 'LNGDES'                             and a04.LANGUE_0 = 'FRA'                             and a04.IDENT1_0 = 24        where /* (ord.ITMREF_0 = '1390M01'          or  ord.ITMREF_0 = 'AR5311200'             or  ord.ITMREF_0 = '300227000') */             (itm.TCLCOD_0 >= %1% and itm.TCLCOD_0 <= %2%)         and ord.STOFCY_0 ='VDP1F'          and ord.WIPSTA_0 <  4          and (ord.ITMREF_0 between %3% and %4% or %3% = ' ')         and ord.ENDDAT_0 between %5% and %6% sql: SELECT       mfg.MFGNUM_0,      mfg.MFGSTA_0,      mfi.TCLCOD_0,      mfi.ITMREF_0,      itm.ITMDES1_0,      itm.TSICOD_3,      mfi.LOT_0,      itm.STU_0,      mfi.CPLQTY_0 AS QTEPRD,          /* Qté produite */      mfitrk.CPLQTY_0 AS QTEPRDPER,    /* Qté produite sur la période */      itm2.TCLCOD_0,      mfm.ITMREF_0,      itm2.ITMDES1_0,      itm2.TSICOD_3,      conso.LOT_0,      itm2.STU_0,      conso.QTECONSPER_0,      conso.QTECONS_0  FROM MFGHEAD mfg  INNER JOIN MFGITM mfi       ON mfg.MFGNUM_0 = mfi.MFGNUM_0  INNER JOIN ITMMASTER itm       ON itm.ITMREF_0 = mfi.ITMREF_0    /* Qté produite sur la période */  LEFT JOIN (      SELECT           MFGNUM_0,          MFGLIN_0,          ITMREF_0,          SUM(CPLQTY_0) AS CPLQTY_0      FROM MFGITMTRK      WHERE ( %3% <= '2000-01-01' OR IPTDAT_0 >= %3% )        AND ( %4% <= '2000-01-01' OR IPTDAT_0 <= %4% )      GROUP BY MFGNUM_0, MFGLIN_0, ITMREF_0  ) mfitrk      ON mfitrk.MFGNUM_0 = mfi.MFGNUM_0     AND mfitrk.MFGLIN_0 = mfi.MFGLIN_0     AND mfitrk.ITMREF_0 = mfi.ITMREF_0    LEFT JOIN MFGMAT mfm       ON mfm.MFGNUM_0 = mfg.MFGNUM_0  LEFT JOIN ITMMASTER itm2       ON itm2.ITMREF_0 = mfm.ITMREF_0    /* Consommations */  LEFT JOIN (      SELECT           ITMREF_0,          LOT_0,          VCRNUMORI_0,          VCRLINORI_0,          ABS(SUM(QTYSTU_0)) AS QTECONS_0,          ABS(SUM(              CASE                   WHEN ( %3% <= '2000-01-01' OR IPTDAT_0 >= %3% )                   AND ( %4% <= '2000-01-01' OR IPTDAT_0 <= %4% )                  THEN QTYSTU_0                   ELSE 0               END          )) AS QTECONSPER_0      FROM STOJOU      GROUP BY ITMREF_0, LOT_0, VCRNUMORI_0, VCRLINORI_0  ) conso      ON conso.ITMREF_0 = mfm.ITMREF_0     AND conso.VCRNUMORI_0 = mfm.MFGNUM_0     AND conso.VCRLINORI_0 = mfm.MFGLIN_0    WHERE      (mfi.CPLQTY_0 <> 0 OR conso.QTECONS_0 <> 0)  AND (%5% = 1 OR conso.QTECONSPER_0 <> 0 OR mfitrk.CPLQTY_0 <> 0)  AND ( ISNULL(%1%, '') = '' OR mfi.TCLCOD_0 = %1% )  AND ( ISNULL(%2%, '') = '' OR itm.TSICOD_3 = %2% )  ORDER BY mfg.MFGNUM_0;

title: rquete cout
description: Requête importée automatiquement depuis l'export SQL Sage X3.
sql: With T1 AS  (  Select STOFCY_0, ITMREF_0, CSTTYP_0, max(ROWID) as ROWIDMAX FROM ITMCOST     Group by STOFCY_0, ITMREF_0 ,CSTTYP_0  ),  CST AS  (  Select T2.STOFCY_0, T2.ITMREF_0, T2.ITCDAT_0, T2.VLTTOT_0,T2.CSTTOT_0, T2.CSTTYP_0  from ITMCOST T2 JOIN T1 ON T1.STOFCY_0 = T2.STOFCY_0    and T1.ITMREF_0=T2.ITMREF_0    and T1.CSTTYP_0 = T2.CSTTYP_0   and T1.ROWIDMAX = T2.ROWID  )     Select I.TCLCOD_0, I.ITMREF_0,I.ITMDES1_0,I.TSICOD_0, I.TSICOD_3,I.CUSREF_0,I.BRDCOD_0, I.XNUMCAS_0, I.YSTADE_0, S.BASPRI_0,F.OFS_0, F.QUALTI_0, F.SAFSTO_0, F.REOMINQTY_0, F.MFGLOTQTY_0, F.MFGLTI_0, CST.CSTTOT_0, CST2.CSTTOT_0     from ITMMASTER I   LEFT JOIN ITMSALES S ON S.ITMREF_0=I.ITMREF_0  LEFT JOIN ITMFACILIT F ON F.ITMREF_0=I.ITMREF_0 AND F.STOFCY_0='VDP1F'  LEFT JOIN CST ON CST.STOFCY_0 = F.STOFCY_0 and CST.ITMREF_0=F.ITMREF_0   and CST.CSTTYP_0 = 1  LEFT JOIN CST CST2 ON CST2.STOFCY_0 = F.STOFCY_0 and CST2.ITMREF_0=F.ITMREF_0   and CST2.CSTTYP_0 = 2  WHERE ((I.TCLCOD_0 >= %1% OR RTRIM(%1%) IS NULL OR  RTRIM(%1%)='') AND   (I.TCLCOD_0 <= %2% OR RTRIM(%2%) IS NULL OR  RTRIM(%2%)='') AND  (I.ITMREF_0 >= %3% OR RTRIM(%3%) IS NULL OR  RTRIM(%3%)='') AND   (I.ITMREF_0 <= %4% OR RTRIM(%4%) IS NULL OR  RTRIM(%4%)=''))

sql: SELECT       ITM.YACTCOD_0 AS [Activité],      BOM.BOMALT_0 AS [Alternative Nomenclature],      BOM.USESTA_0 AS [Statut nomenclature],      BOM.ITMREF_0 AS [Code article],        /* Critère */      ITM.ITMDES1_0 AS [Désignation article],      BOM.ZNUMEDI_0 AS [Num. Edition],        /* Critère */      BOM.CREUSR_0 AS [Utilisateur création],      XVE.XVERSION_0 AS [N° Version],         /* Critère */      XVE.XGESCOUT_0 AS [Version coût],       /* Critère */      BOM.CREDAT_0 AS [Date création]  FROM BOM BOM  INNER JOIN ITMMASTER ITM      ON ITM.ITMREF_0 = BOM.ITMREF_0  LEFT JOIN XITMVERSIO XVE      ON XVE.ITMREF_0 = BOM.ITMREF_0     AND XVE.BOMALT_0 = BOM.BOMALT_0  WHERE BOM.BOMALT_0 < 50    AND (%1% = '' OR ITM.YACTCOD_0 = %1%)    AND (%2% = '' OR BOM.ZNUMEDI_0 LIKE %2%)    AND (%3% = '' OR BOM.ITMREF_0 = %3%)    AND (%4% = '' OR XVE.XVERSION_0 = %4%)    /* AND (%7% = '' OR XVE.XPLANIF_0 = %7%) */    AND ((%5% = '' AND %6% = '') OR (ITM.ITMSTA_0 BETWEEN %5% AND %6%))    AND (%7% <= '20000101' OR BOM.CREDAT_0 >= %7%);

title: AQ - Suivi conso OF 2
description: Requête importée automatiquement depuis l'export SQL Sage X3.
sql: select itmmaster.ITMREF_0  , itmmaster.ITMDES1_0  , mfgmattrk.MFGNUM_0  , sum(case when mfgmattrk.MATTYP_0 <> 3 then mfgmattrk.USEQTY_0 else mfgmattrk.USEQTY_0*(-1) end)  , mfgmattrk.STU_0  , stojou.LOT_0  , convert(nvarchar(250),(select xrequesth.XREQNUM_0 + '['+ case when xrequesth.XVALDAT_0 < '1800-01-01' then 'N/A' else convert(varchar, xrequesth.XVALDAT_0, 101) end +']' + '(' + aplstd_XTRANSAC .LANMES_0 + ')//'   from XREQUESTH xrequesth    inner join APLSTD aplstd_XTRANSAC on aplstd_XTRANSAC.LANNUM_0=xrequesth.XTRANSAC_0 and aplstd_XTRANSAC.LANCHP_0 = 1011 and aplstd_XTRANSAC.LAN_0='FRA'   where xrequesth.XITMREF_0=mfgmattrk.ITMREF_0 and xrequesth.XLOT_0=stojou.LOT_0 FOR XML PATH (''))) as QCORDER  from ITMMASTER itmmaster  inner join MFGMATTRK mfgmattrk on itmmaster.ITMREF_0=mfgmattrk.ITMREF_0  inner join STOJOU stojou on stojou.VCRNUM_0=mfgmattrk.MFGTRKNUM_0 and stojou.ITMREF_0=mfgmattrk.ITMREF_0    WHERE (mfgmattrk.IPTDAT_0 >= %1% or %1%='01/01/00')   and (mfgmattrk.IPTDAT_0 <= %2% or %2%='01/01/00')         and (itmmaster.TCLCOD_0 >= %3% or %3%='')   and (itmmaster.TCLCOD_0 <= %4% or %4%='')   and (itmmaster.YACTCOD_0 = %5% or %5%='')   and (mfgmattrk.MFGNUM_0 = %6% or %6%='')      GROUP BY itmmaster.ITMREF_0    , mfgmattrk.ITMREF_0    , itmmaster.ITMDES1_0    , mfgmattrk.MFGNUM_0    , mfgmattrk.STU_0    , stojou.LOT_0

title: Mouvement de stock (Achat)-BKP
description: Requête importée automatiquement depuis l'export SQL Sage X3.
sql: SELECT STOFCY_0,stj.ITMREF_0,ITMDES1_0,IPTDAT_0,LOT_0  ,SUM(QTYPCU_0)  , stj.PCU_0  , SUM(QTYSTU_0)  ,stj.STU_0  ,TRSTYP_0  ,VCRTYP_0  ,VCRTYPORI_0  ,BPSLOT_0, stj.POT_0  ,sum(ACTQTY_0),sum(AMTORD_0),sum(AMTVAL_0)  ,PRIVAL_0  ,sum(VARORD_0)  ,PRINAT_0  ,SUM(VARVAL_0)  ,PRIORD_0  ,stj.CCE_0,stj.CCE_1,stj.CCE_2  FROM   STOJOU stj inner join ITMMASTER itm on stj.ITMREF_0 = itm.ITMREF_0     WHERE    (stj.CREDAT_0 >= %1% or %1% <= '2000-01-01')  and (stj.CREDAT_0 <= %2% or %2% <= '2000-01-01')  and (IPTDAT_0 >= %3% or %3% <= '2000-01-01')  and (IPTDAT_0 <= %4% or %4% <= '2000-01-01')  and (stj.ITMREF_0 = %5% or %5% = '')  and (TCLCOD_0 = %6% or %6% = '')  and (    (%7% = '2' and TRSTYP_0 not in (7,8,9,21,25) and VCRTYP_0 not in (35)) or    (%8% = '2' and  (TRSTYP_0 in (7,8,9,21,25) or VCRTYP_0 in (35))) or     (%9% = '2'  and TRSTYP_0 in (23)))   and REGFLG_0 <= %10%  and TRSTYP_0 <> 0 and UPDCOD_0 = 2  GROUP BY     STOFCY_0,stj.ITMREF_0,ITMDES1_0,IPTDAT_0,LOT_0   , stj.PCU_0   ,stj.STU_0   ,TRSTYP_0   ,VCRTYP_0   ,VCRTYPORI_0   ,BPSLOT_0, stj.POT_0   ,PRIVAL_0   ,PRINAT_0   ,PRIORD_0   ,stj.CCE_0,stj.CCE_1,stj.CCE_2

title: Mouvement de stock (Achat)

sql: SELECT stj.STOFCY_0   ,stj.ITMREF_0   ,itm.ITMDES1_0   ,stj.IPTDAT_0   ,stj.LOT_0   ,stj.VCRNUM_0   ,stj.VCRNUMORI_0   ,stj2.BPRNUM_0   ,bps.BPSNAM_0   ,SUM(stj.QTYPCU_0)   ,stj.PCU_0   ,SUM(stj.QTYSTU_0)   ,stj.STU_0   ,stj.TRSTYP_0   ,stj.VCRTYP_0   ,stj.VCRTYPORI_0   ,stj.BPSLOT_0   ,stj.POT_0   ,sum(stj.ACTQTY_0)   ,sum(stj.AMTORD_0)   ,sum(stj.AMTVAL_0)   ,stj.PRIVAL_0   ,sum(stj.VARORD_0)   ,stj.PRINAT_0   ,SUM(stj.VARVAL_0)   ,stj.PRIORD_0   ,stj.CCE_0   ,stj.CCE_1   ,stj.CCE_2     FROM   STOJOU stj    inner join ITMMASTER itm     on stj.ITMREF_0 = itm.ITMREF_0   left join STOJOU stj2    on stj2.ITMREF_0 = stj.ITMREF_0    and stj2.LOT_0 = stj.LOT_0    and stj2.TRSFAM_0 = 'REC'   left join BPSUPPLIER bps    on bps.BPSNUM_0 = stj2.BPRNUM_0     WHERE    (stj.CREDAT_0 >= %1% or %1% <= '2000-01-01')    and (stj.CREDAT_0 <= %2% or %2% <= '2000-01-01')    and (stj.IPTDAT_0 >= %3% or %3% <= '2000-01-01')    and (stj.IPTDAT_0 <= %4% or %4% <= '2000-01-01')    and (stj.ITMREF_0 = %5% or %5% = '')    and (itm.TCLCOD_0 BETWEEN %6% AND %7% or %6% = '' and %7% = '')     and (      (%8% = '2' and stj.TRSTYP_0 not in (7,8,9,21,25) and stj.VCRTYP_0 not in (35)) or      (%9% = '2' and  (stj.TRSTYP_0 in (7,8,9,21,25) or stj.VCRTYP_0 in (35))) or       (%10% = '2'  and stj.TRSTYP_0 in (23)))     and stj.REGFLG_0 <= %11%    and stj.TRSTYP_0 <> 0 and stj.UPDCOD_0 = 2    and (itm.YACTCOD_0 >= %12% and itm.YACTCOD_0 <= %13%)    and ((%14% = '' and %15% = '') or(stj2.BPRNUM_0 >= %14% and stj2.BPRNUM_0 <= %15%))    GROUP BY     stj.STOFCY_0   ,stj.ITMREF_0   ,itm.ITMDES1_0   ,stj.IPTDAT_0   ,stj.LOT_0   ,stj.VCRNUM_0   ,stj.VCRNUMORI_0   ,stj2.BPRNUM_0   ,bps.BPSNAM_0   ,stj.PCU_0   ,stj.STU_0   ,stj.TRSTYP_0   ,stj.VCRTYP_0   ,stj.VCRTYPORI_0   ,stj.BPSLOT_0   ,stj.POT_0   ,stj.PRIVAL_0   ,stj.PRINAT_0   ,stj.PRIORD_0   ,stj.CCE_0   ,stj.CCE_1   ,stj.CCE_2

title: STAB - Echéances stabilité

title: Méthode contrôle par article
description: Requête importée automatiquement depuis l'export SQL Sage X3.
sql: SELECT       XFD.XCODEMETH_0,      XFD.XCODEFICH_0,      XFD.XVERSION_0,      XFD.XCODCTRL_0,      XFD.XCOALIB_0,      ITM.ITMREF_0,      ITM.ITMDES1_0,      CASE           WHEN ITM.ITMSTA_0 = 1 THEN 'Actif'          WHEN ITM.ITMSTA_0 = 4 THEN 'Fin de vie'          WHEN ITM.ITMSTA_0 = 6 THEN 'Inactif'          ELSE NULL      END AS STATUT  FROM       XFICHCTRLD XFD      INNER JOIN XFICHCTRLH XFH          ON XFH.XCODEFICH_0 = XFD.XCODEFICH_0          AND XFH.XVERSION_0 = XFD.XVERSION_0      INNER JOIN ITMFACILIT ITF          ON ITF.ITMREF_0 = ITF.ITMREF_0          AND (              ITF.XPLANCTRL_0 = XFD.XCODEFICH_0              OR ITF.XPLANCTRL_1 = XFD.XCODEFICH_0              OR ITF.XPLANCTRL_2 = XFD.XCODEFICH_0              OR ITF.XPLANCTRL_3 = XFD.XCODEFICH_0              OR ITF.XPLANCTRL_4 = XFD.XCODEFICH_0          )      INNER JOIN ITMMASTER ITM          ON ITM.ITMREF_0 = ITF.ITMREF_0  WHERE       XFH.XACTIF_0 = '2'      AND ((%1% = '') OR (XFD.XCODEMETH_0 = %1%))      AND ((%2% = '') OR (XFD.XCODEFICH_0 = %2%))      AND ((%3% = '') OR (XFD.XCODCTRL_0 = %3%))      AND ((%4% = '') OR (ITM.ITMREF_0 = %4%))      AND ((%5% = '' AND %6% = '') OR (ITM.ITMSTA_0 >= %5% AND ITM.ITMSTA_0 <= %6%))

title: Utilisteurs et fonctions.
