sql: select aut.NOMUSR_0 as 'Nom Utilisateur'          ,aut.USR_0 as 'Trigramme'            ,case            when aut.ENAFLG_0 <> 2 then 'Inactif'            else 'Actif'          end as 'Statut'            ,aft.PRFCOD_0 as 'Code Profil'         ,afc.ALLACS_0 as 'Tout accés'         ,afc.ALLFCT_0 as 'Toutes fonctions'         ,aft.FNC_0 as 'Fonction'         ,atxt.TEXTE_0 as 'Désignation fonction'         ,aft.ACS_0 as 'Droit'         ,aft.OPT_0 as 'Option'                  from VDRPROD.AUTILIS aut  join VDRPROD.AFCTFCT afc on afc.PRFCOD_0 = aut.PRFFCT_0  left join VDRPROD.AFCTPRF aft on aft.PRFCOD_0 = afc.PRFCOD_0  left join VDRPROD.AFONCTION afo on afo.CODINT_0 = aft.FNC_0  left join VDRPROD.ATEXTE atxt on atxt.NUMERO_0 = afo.NOM_0 and atxt.LAN_0 = 'FRA'    where  (aut.ENAFLG_0 = 2          /* Pour les profils actifs              */         and aft.PRFCOD_0 = %1%     /* Profil Fonction  */         and aft.ACS_0 = 2          /* Doit avoir accès à la fonction       */         and aft.OPT_0 <> ' '       /* Doit avoir des droits sur la fonction*/ )  or          (afc.ALLFCT_0 = '2'        /* Pour les profils toutes fonctions   */           and aut.ENAFLG_0 = 2     /* pour les profils actifs */                      and aut.USR_0 <> 'BATCH'           and aut.USR_0 <> 'ADMIN' )                                                                                                                                                                        order by   aut.NOMUSR_0

title: Vérification Gammes
description: Requête importée automatiquement depuis l'export SQL Sage X3.
sql: SELECT       ITM.YACTCOD_0 AS [Activité],      ROU.ROUALT_0 AS [Alternative gamme],      ROU.USESTA_0 AS [Statut gamme],      ROU.ITMREF_0 AS [Code article],       /* Critère */      ITM.ITMDES1_0 AS [Désignation article],      ROU.PLNNUM_0 AS [Plan entête gamme],  /* Critère */      ROU.CREUSR_0 AS [Utilisateur création],      XVE.XVERSION_0 AS [N° Version],       /* Critère */      XVE.XGESCOUT_0 AS [Version coût],     /* Critère */      ROU.CREDAT_0 AS [Date création]  FROM ROUTING ROU  INNER JOIN ITMMASTER ITM      ON ITM.ITMREF_0 = ROU.ITMREF_0  LEFT JOIN XITMVERSIO XVE      ON XVE.ITMREF_0 = ROU.ITMREF_0     AND XVE.ROUALT_0 = ROU.ROUALT_0  WHERE ROU.ROUALT_0 < 89    AND (%1% = '' OR ITM.YACTCOD_0 = %1%)    AND (%2% = '' OR ROU.PLNNUM_0 LIKE %2%)    AND (%3% = '' OR ROU.ITMREF_0 = %3%)    AND (%4% = '' OR XVE.XVERSION_0 = %4%)    /* AND (%7% = '' OR XVE.XPLANIF_0 = %7%) */    AND ((%5% = '' AND %6% = '') OR (ITM.ITMSTA_0 BETWEEN %5% AND %6%))    AND (%7% <= '20000101' OR ROU.CREDAT_0 >= %7%);

title: Version complète
description: Requête importée automatiquement depuis l'export SQL Sage X3.
sql: SELECT       itm.YACTCOD_0 AS 'Activité',      ver.ITMREF_0 AS 'Code article',      itm.ITMDES1_0 AS 'Désignation article',      ver.XVERSION_0 AS 'N° Version',      ver.XVERSDES1_0 AS 'Désignation Version',      ver.BOMALT_0 AS 'Alternative Nomenclature',      ver.ROUNUM_0 AS 'Gamme',      ver.ROUALT_0 AS 'Alternative de Gamme',      ver.XVERSTRDAT_0 AS 'Début validité',      ver.XVERENDDAT_0 AS 'Fin validité',      ver.XPLANIF_0 AS 'Cochée PLANIF',      ver.XVERSBLOQ_0 AS 'Cochée BLOQUEE',      ver.XGESCOUT_0 AS 'Cochée COUT',      ver.XTYPCOUT_0 AS 'Type de coût',      itm.ITMSTA_0 AS 'Statut article',      SUBSTRING(          CAST(ver.XTAIBATMAX_0 AS VARCHAR),          1,          CHARINDEX('.', CAST(ver.XTAIBATMAX_0 AS VARCHAR)) - 1      ) AS 'Taille batch Max',      ver.XVERSDES2_0 AS 'Désignation 2 Version',      ver.CREUSR_0 AS 'Utilisateur création',      ver.CREDAT_0 AS 'Date création'  FROM XITMVERSIO ver  INNER JOIN ITMMASTER itm       ON itm.ITMREF_0 = ver.ITMREF_0  WHERE      (%1% = '' OR itm.YACTCOD_0 = %1%)  AND (%2% = '' OR ver.ITMREF_0 = %2%)  AND (%3% = '' OR ver.XVERSION_0 = %3%)  AND (%4% = '' OR ver.ROUNUM_0 = %4%)  AND (%5% = '' OR ver.XGESCOUT_0 = %5%)  AND (%6% = '' OR ver.XVERSBLOQ_0 = %6%)  -- AND (%7% = '' OR ver.XPLANIF_0 = %7%)  AND (          (%7% = '' AND %8% = '')       OR itm.ITMSTA_0 BETWEEN %7% AND %8%      )  AND (          %11% <= '01/01/2000'       OR ver.XVERENDDAT_0 >= %11%      )  AND (          %12% <= '01/01/2000'       OR ver.XVERENDDAT_0 <= %12%      )  AND (          %9% <= '01/01/2000'       OR ver.XVERSTRDAT_0 >= %9%      )  AND (          %10% <= '01/01/2000'       OR ver.XVERSTRDAT_0 <= %10%      );

title: Commandes achat en cours
description: Requête importée automatiquement depuis l'export SQL Sage X3.
sql: select porder.BUY_0   , porderq.POHNUM_0         , porder.ORDREF_0   , porderq.ITMREF_0   , itmmaster.TCLCOD_0   , porderp.ITMDES_0   , bpsupplier.BPSNAM_0   , porderq.XSTA_0   , porderq.EXTRCPDAT_0   , porderq.XEXTRCPDAT_0   , porder.ORDDAT_0   , porder.RCPFLG_0   , porderq.QTYSTU_0   , sum(isnull(preceiptd.QTYSTU_0,0))   , porderp.NETPRI_0 * ( porderq.QTYPUU_0/porderq.QTYSTU_0)   , porderq.QTYSTU_0*(porderp.NETPRI_0* ( porderq.QTYPUU_0/porderq.QTYSTU_0))   , porder.XFCYADD_0   , porderq.LINCLEFLG_0   , Case     When itmmaster.PCU_0 = 'PAL' then itmmaster.PCUSTUCOE_0    When itmmaster.PCU_1 = 'PAL' then itmmaster.PCUSTUCOE_1    When itmmaster.PCU_2 = 'PAL' then itmmaster.PCUSTUCOE_2    When itmmaster.PCU_3 = 'PAL' then itmmaster.PCUSTUCOE_3    else '1'   End as PCUSTUCOE   ,CEILING(porderq.QTYSTU_0 /       (Case           When itmmaster.PCU_0 = 'PAL' then itmmaster.PCUSTUCOE_0          When itmmaster.PCU_1 = 'PAL' then itmmaster.PCUSTUCOE_1          When itmmaster.PCU_2 = 'PAL' then itmmaster.PCUSTUCOE_2          When itmmaster.PCU_3 = 'PAL' then itmmaster.PCUSTUCOE_3          else 1      End)),   CONVERT(VARCHAR(255),aclob.CLOB_0) as 'Texte'     from PORDERQ porderq  inner join PORDERP porderp    on porderp.POHNUM_0=porderq.POHNUM_0    and porderp.POPLIN_0=porderq.POPLIN_0  inner join ITMMASTER itmmaster    on itmmaster.ITMREF_0=porderq.ITMREF_0  inner join BPSUPPLIER bpsupplier    on bpsupplier.BPSNUM_0=porderq.BPSNUM_0  inner join PORDER porder    on porder.POHNUM_0=porderq.POHNUM_0  left join PRECEIPTD preceiptd    on preceiptd.POHNUM_0=porderq.POHNUM_0    and preceiptd.POPLIN_0=porderq.POPLIN_0  left join ACLOB aclob   on aclob.IDENT1_0 = porderq.POHNUM_0    where porder.CLEFLG_0 <> 2        and porderq.RCPCLEFLG_0 <> 2        and porderq.LINCLEFLG_0 between %1%        and %2%  group by porder.BUY_0   , porderq.POHNUM_0   , porderq.ITMREF_0   , itmmaster.TCLCOD_0   , porderp.ITMDES_0   , bpsupplier.BPSNAM_0   , porderq.XSTA_0   , porderq.EXTRCPDAT_0   , porderq.XEXTRCPDAT_0   , porder.ORDDAT_0   , porder.RCPFLG_0   , porder.XSTA_0   , porderq.QTYSTU_0      , porderq.QTYPUU_0   , porderp.NETPRI_0   , porderq.POPLIN_0   , porder.XFCYADD_0   , porderq.LINCLEFLG_0      , porder.ORDREF_0      , itmmaster.PCU_0      , Case     When itmmaster.PCU_0 = 'PAL' then itmmaster.PCUSTUCOE_0    When itmmaster.PCU_1 = 'PAL' then itmmaster.PCUSTUCOE_1    When itmmaster.PCU_2 = 'PAL' then itmmaster.PCUSTUCOE_2    When itmmaster.PCU_3 = 'PAL' then itmmaster.PCUSTUCOE_3    else '1'   End   ,CEILING(porderq.QTYSTU_0 /       (Case           When itmmaster.PCU_0 = 'PAL' then itmmaster.PCUSTUCOE_0          When itmmaster.PCU_1 = 'PAL' then itmmaster.PCUSTUCOE_1          When itmmaster.PCU_2 = 'PAL' then itmmaster.PCUSTUCOE_2          When itmmaster.PCU_3 = 'PAL' then itmmaster.PCUSTUCOE_3          else 1      End))   , CONVERT(VARCHAR(255),aclob.CLOB_0)

sql: SELECT DISTINCT      SDD.SDHNUM_0,      SDD.SDDLIN_0,      SDD.BPCORD_0,      BPC.BPCNAM_0,      SDD.BPAADD_0,      SDD.SHIDAT_0,      SDD.ITMREF_0,      SDD.ITMDES1_0,      SDD.QTY_0,      SDD.SAU_0,      STJ.LOT_0,      SDD.RTNQTY_0,      SDD.NETPRI_0,      SDD.NETPRIATI_0,      SDL.CUR_0,      SDD.PFM_0,      SDD.CPRPRI_0,      SDL.VACBPR_0,      SDL.BPCINV_0,      SDL.BPINAM_0,      SDL.BPCPYR_0,      BPC2.BPCNAM_0,      SDL.BPCGRU_0,      BPC3.BPCNAM_0,      SDL.SALFCY_0,      SDL.STOFCY_0,      SDL.BPTNUM_0,      SDL.SOHNUM_0,      CASE          WHEN MFG.MFGNUM_0 IS NOT NULL AND MFG.MFGNUM_0 <> '' THEN MFG.MFGNUM_0          ELSE STJ2.VCRNUMORI_0      END AS OF_ORIGINE,      SDL.REP_0,      SDL.REP_1  FROM SDELIVERYD SDD  INNER JOIN BPCUSTOMER BPC      ON BPC.BPCNUM_0 = SDD.BPCORD_0  INNER JOIN SDELIVERY SDL      ON SDL.SDHNUM_0 = SDD.SDHNUM_0  INNER JOIN BPCUSTOMER BPC2      ON BPC2.BPCNUM_0 = SDL.BPCPYR_0  INNER JOIN BPCUSTOMER BPC3      ON BPC3.BPCNUM_0 = SDL.BPCGRU_0  LEFT JOIN STOJOU STJ      ON STJ.ITMREF_0 = SDD.ITMREF_0     AND STJ.VCRNUM_0 = SDD.SDHNUM_0     AND STJ.VCRLIN_0 = SDD.SDDLIN_0  LEFT JOIN MFGMAT MFG      ON MFG.LOT_0 = STJ.LOT_0     AND MFG.ITMREF_0 = STJ.ITMREF_0  LEFT JOIN STOJOU STJ2      ON STJ2.ITMREF_0 = SDD.ITMREF_0     AND STJ2.VCRNUM_0 = SDD.SDHNUM_0     AND STJ2.VCRLIN_0 = SDD.SDDLIN_0     AND STJ2.LOT_0 = STJ.LOT_0     AND STJ2.VCRTYPORI_0 = '10'  WHERE      (%1% = '' AND %2% = '' OR SDL.CFMFLG_0 BETWEEN %1% AND %2%)      AND (%3% = '' AND %4% = '' OR SDD.SDHNUM_0 BETWEEN %3% AND %4%)      AND (%5% = '' AND %6% = '' OR SDD.ITMREF_0 BETWEEN %5% AND %6%)      AND (%7% = '' AND %8% = '' OR SDD.SHIDAT_0 BETWEEN %7% AND %8%)      AND (%9% = '' AND %10% = '' OR SDD.BPCORD_0 BETWEEN %9% AND %10%)      AND (%11% = '' AND %12% = '' OR SDL.INVFLG_0 BETWEEN %11% AND %12%)      AND (%13% = '' AND %14% = '' OR SDL.RTNSTA_0 BETWEEN %13% AND %14%)      AND (%15% = '' AND %16% = '' OR SDL.SOHNUM_0 BETWEEN %15% AND %16%);

title: Cas d’emploi avec versions

sql: SELECT       bom.ITMREF_0,      bom.BOMALT_0,      bom.BOMALTTYP_0,      itm2.ITMDES1_0,      bom.BASQTY_0,      bod.CPNITMREF_0,      itm.ITMDES1_0,      bod.LIKQTYCOD_0,      bod.BOMQTY_0,      xiv.XVERSION_0,      xiv.XVERSTRDAT_0,      xiv.XVERENDDAT_0  FROM BOM bom  INNER JOIN BOMD bod      ON bod.ITMREF_0 = bom.ITMREF_0     AND bod.BOMALT_0 = bom.BOMALT_0     AND bod.BOMALTTYP_0 = bom.BOMALTTYP_0  INNER JOIN ITMMASTER itm      ON itm.ITMREF_0 = bod.CPNITMREF_0  INNER JOIN ITMMASTER itm2      ON itm2.ITMREF_0 = bom.ITMREF_0  LEFT JOIN XITMVERSIO xiv      ON xiv.ITMREF_0 = bom.ITMREF_0     AND xiv.BOMALT_0 = bom.BOMALT_0     AND xiv.BOMALTTYP_0 = bom.BOMALTTYP_0     AND %1% BETWEEN xiv.XVERSTRDAT_0 AND xiv.XVERENDDAT_0     AND xiv.XGESCOUT_0 = 1  WHERE      (bom.ITMREF_0 = %2% OR %2% = '')  AND (bom.BOMALT_0 >= %3% OR %3% = '')  AND (bom.BOMALT_0 <= %4% OR %4% = '')  AND (bod.CPNITMREF_0 = %5% OR %5% = '')  AND xiv.XVERSION_0 IS NOT NULL  ORDER BY      bom.ITMREF_0,      bom.BOMALT_0,      bod.BOMSEQ_0;

,ITMMASTER.ITMSTD_0   ,ITMMASTER.ITMSTA_0   ,ITMMASTER.TSICOD_0   ,CASE    WHEN ITMMASTER.TSICOD_0 = '' THEN ''    ELSE ATEXTRA2.TEXTE_0   END   ,ITMMASTER.LIFSTRDAT_0   ,ITMMASTER.LIFENDDAT_0   ,ITMMASTER.PLMITMREF_0   ,ITMMASTER.TSICOD_1   ,CASE    WHEN ITMMASTER.TSICOD_1 = '' THEN ''    ELSE ATEXTRA3.TEXTE_0   END   ,ITMMASTER.TSICOD_2   ,CASE    WHEN ITMMASTER.TSICOD_2 = '' THEN ''    ELSE ATEXTRA4.TEXTE_0   END   ,ITMMASTER.TSICOD_3   ,CASE    WHEN ITMMASTER.TSICOD_3 = '' THEN ''    ELSE ATEXTRA5.TEXTE_0   END   ,ITMMASTER.CUSREF_0   ,ITMMASTER.EECGES_0   ,ITMMASTER.BRDCOD_0   ,ITMMASTER.XNUMCAS_0   ,ITMMASTER.STU_0   ,ITMMASTER.PUU_0   ,ITMMASTER.PUUSTUCOE_0   ,ITMMASTER.SAU_0   ,ITMMASTER.ACCCOD_0   ,ITMMASTER.VACITM_0   ,ITMMASTER.CCE_0   ,CASE    WHEN ITMMASTER.CCE_0 = '' THEN ''    ELSE ATEXTRA6.TEXTE_0   END   ,ITMMASTER.CCE_1   ,ITMMASTER.CCE_2   ,ITMSALES.BASPRI_0   ,ITMMASTER.XPROVCUST_0   ,ITMFACILIT.PLANNER_0   ,ITMFACILIT.BUY_0   ,ITMFACILIT.OFS_0   ,ITMFACILIT.QUALTI_0   ,ITMFACILIT.SAFSTO_0   ,ITMFACILIT.REOMINQTY_0   ,ITMFACILIT.MFGLOTQTY_0   ,ITMFACILIT.REOPOL_0   ,ITMFACILIT.MFGLTI_0   ,ITMMASTER.XCLIFOU_0   ,ITMFACILIT.ZYIELD_0   ,ITMMASTER.ZREFINSTR_0   ,ITMMASTER.YSTADE_0   ,ITMMASTER.YFAMLOT_0   ,ITMMASTER.YVOLUTION_0    From ITMMASTER ITMMASTER   LEFT JOIN ATEXTRA ATEXTRA    on (ATEXTRA.CODFIC_0 = 'ITMCATEG'     and ATEXTRA.IDENT1_0 = ITMMASTER.TCLCOD_0      and  ATEXTRA.ZONE_0='TCLAXX'     and ATEXTRA.LANGUE_0='FRA')   LEFT JOIN ITMFACILIT ITMFACILIT    on ITMFACILIT.ITMREF_0 = ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0   LEFT JOIN ATEXTRA ATEXTRA2     on (ATEXTRA2.IDENT1_0='20'     and ATEXTRA2.IDENT2_0 = ITMMASTER.TSICOD_0      and  ATEXTRA2.ZONE_0='LNGDES'     and ATEXTRA2.CODFIC_0='ATABDIV'    and ATEXTRA2.LANGUE_0='FRA')   LEFT JOIN ATEXTRA ATEXTRA3     on (ATEXTRA3.IDENT1_0='21'     and ATEXTRA3.IDENT2_0 = ITMMASTER.TSICOD_1      and  ATEXTRA3.ZONE_0='LNGDES'      and ATEXTRA3.CODFIC_0='ATABDIV'    and ATEXTRA3.LANGUE_0='FRA')   LEFT JOIN ATEXTRA ATEXTRA4     on (ATEXTRA4.IDENT1_0='22'     and ATEXTRA4.IDENT2_0 = ITMMASTER.TSICOD_2      and  ATEXTRA4.ZONE_0='LNGDES'      and ATEXTRA4.CODFIC_0='ATABDIV'    and ATEXTRA4.LANGUE_0='FRA')   LEFT JOIN ATEXTRA ATEXTRA5     on (ATEXTRA5.IDENT1_0='23'     and ATEXTRA5.IDENT2_0 = ITMMASTER.TSICOD_3      and  ATEXTRA5.ZONE_0='LNGDES'      and ATEXTRA5.CODFIC_0='ATABDIV'    and ATEXTRA5.LANGUE_0='FRA')   LEFT JOIN ATEXTRA ATEXTRA6     on (ATEXTRA6.IDENT1_0='COC'     and ATEXTRA6.IDENT2_0 = ITMMASTER.CCE_0      and  ATEXTRA6.ZONE_0='DESTRA'      and ATEXTRA6.CODFIC_0='CACCE'    and ATEXTRA6.LANGUE_0='FRA')   LEFT JOIN ITMSALES ITMSALES    on ITMSALES.ITMREF_0 = ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0      where ITMFACILIT.STOFCY_0 = 'VDP1F'   AND ((%1% = '' and %2% = '') or (ITMMASTER.TCLCOD_0 >= %1% and ITMMASTER.TCLCOD_0 <= %2%))   AND ((%3% = '' and %4% = '') or (ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 >= %3% and ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 <= %4%))   AND ((%5% = '' and %6% = '') or (ITMMASTER.ITMSTA_0 >= %5% and ITMMASTER.ITMSTA_0 <= %6%))   AND ((%7% = '' and %8% = '') or (ITMMASTER.SEAKEY_0 >= %7% and ITMMASTER.SEAKEY_0 <= %8%))   AND ((%9% = '' and %10% = '') or (ITMMASTER.TSICOD_0 >= %9% and ITMMASTER.TSICOD_0 <= %10%))   AND ((%11% = '' and %12% = '') or (ITMMASTER.PLMITMREF_0 >= %11% and ITMMASTER.PLMITMREF_0 <= %12%))   AND ((%13% = '' and %14% = '') or (ITMMASTER.TSICOD_1 >= %13% and ITMMASTER.TSICOD_1 <= %14%))   AND ((%15% = '' and %16% = '') or (ITMMASTER.TSICOD_2 >= %15% and ITMMASTER.TSICOD_2 <= %16%))

title: Verif Création Ver. Prod/Fin
description: Requête importée automatiquement depuis l'export SQL Sage X3.
sql: SELECT       xiv.ITMREF_0,      itm.ITMDES1_0,      CASE           WHEN xiv.XPLANIF_0 = 2 THEN 'Version finance non créée'          WHEN xiv.XGESCOUT_0 = 2 THEN 'Version production non créée'      END AS [Commentaire],      itm.TCLCOD_0,      itm.ITMSTA_0,      itf.VLTCOD_0  FROM XITMVERSIO xiv  INNER JOIN ITMMASTER itm       ON xiv.ITMREF_0 = itm.ITMREF_0  INNER JOIN ITMFACILIT itf       ON xiv.ITMREF_0 = itf.ITMREF_0  WHERE %1% BETWEEN xiv.XVERSTRDAT_0 AND xiv.XVERENDDAT_0  AND (      (xiv.XPLANIF_0 = 2        AND NOT EXISTS (           SELECT 1            FROM XITMVERSIO xiv2           WHERE xiv2.XGESCOUT_0 = 2             AND %1% BETWEEN xiv2.XVERSTRDAT_0 AND xiv2.XVERENDDAT_0             AND xiv2.ITMREF_0 = xiv.ITMREF_0       ))      OR      (xiv.XGESCOUT_0 = 2       AND NOT EXISTS (           SELECT 1            FROM XITMVERSIO xiv2           WHERE xiv2.XPLANIF_0 = 2             AND %1% BETWEEN xiv2.XVERSTRDAT_0 AND xiv2.XVERENDDAT_0             AND xiv2.ITMREF_0 = xiv.ITMREF_0       ))  );

title: IRSN V2
description: Requête importée automatiquement depuis l'export SQL Sage X3.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT      STL.REFPER_0 AS DateFabrication,      STL.ITMREF_0 AS CodeArticle,      STL.LOT_0 AS Lot,      STL.SLO_0 AS Contenants,      STJ.QTYSTU_0 AS QteFabriquee,      STJ.STU_0 AS UniteStock,      CASE          WHEN STJ.TRSFAM_0 = 'SOF' THEN 'CONSOMMATION'          WHEN STJ.TRSFAM_0 = 'EOF' THEN 'PRODUCTION'          WHEN STJ.TRSFAM_0 = 'REO' THEN 'REINTEGRATION'          WHEN STJ.TRSFAM_0 = 'LIV' THEN 'LIVRAISON'          WHEN STJ.TRSFAM_0 = 'DES' THEN 'DESTRUCTION'      END AS Type,      CASE          WHEN STJ.QTYSTU_0 > 0 AND STJ.TRSFAM_0 <> 'REO' THEN 1          WHEN STJ.QTYSTU_0 < 0 AND STJ.TRSFAM_0 <> 'REO' THEN 2          WHEN STJ.TRSFAM_0 = 'REO' THEN 3          WHEN STJ.TRSFAM_0 = 'LIV' THEN 4          WHEN STJ.TRSFAM_0 = 'DES' THEN 5      END AS OrdreType,      STJ.LOC_0 AS Emplacement    FROM STOJOU STJ  INNER JOIN ITMMASTER ITM      ON ITM.ITMREF_0 = STJ.ITMREF_0  INNER JOIN STOLOT STL      ON STL.ITMREF_0 = STJ.ITMREF_0      AND STL.LOT_0 = STJ.LOT_0      AND STL.SLO_0 = STJ.SLO_0  LEFT JOIN MFGHEADTRK MTH      ON MTH.MFGTRKNUM_0 = STJ.VCRNUM_0  LEFT JOIN SDELIVERY SDH      ON SDH.SDHNUM_0 = STJ.VCRNUM_0    WHERE ITM.ZPCOD_0 = 2    AND STJ.TRSFAM_0 NOT IN ('RGT','REA','ECH','AQ','CHU','CSSFC','','ENTD','INV','CSPFC','PREP','REL','RET','FAL')    AND STJ.VCRNUM_0 NOT LIKE '00000%'    AND ITM.YACTCOD_0 BETWEEN %1% AND %2%    AND STL.REFPER_0 BETWEEN %3% AND %4%    AND ITM.TCLCOD_0 BETWEEN %5% AND %6%    AND STJ.ITMREF_0 BETWEEN %7% AND %8%    AND STJ.LOT_0 BETWEEN %9% AND %10%    ORDER BY      STL.REFPER_0 ASC,      STL.LOT_0 ASC,      STL.SLO_0 ASC,      OrdreType ASC;

title: Suivi récept/QC Order lot frn
description: Requête importée automatiquement depuis l'export SQL Sage X3.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT      stl.VCRTYP_0,      stl.VCRNUM_0,      prh.RCPDAT_0,        stl.ITMREF_0,      itm.ITMDES1_0,      itm.TCLCOD_0,        stl.LOT_0,      stl.BPSLOT_0,      stl.LOTCREDAT_0,        stl.BPSNUM_0,      bps.BPSNAM_0,        xrh.XREQNUM_0,      xrh.XTRANSAC_0,      xrh.XSTATUT_0,      xrh.XSTAFORCE_0,      xrh.XCOMMENT_0    FROM STOLOT stl  INNER JOIN ITMMASTER itm      ON itm.ITMREF_0 = stl.ITMREF_0    LEFT JOIN BPSUPPLIER bps      ON bps.BPSNUM_0 = stl.BPSNUM_0    LEFT JOIN PRECEIPT prh      ON prh.PTHNUM_0 = stl.VCRNUM_0    LEFT JOIN XREQUESTH xrh      ON xrh.XLOT_0 = stl.LOT_0    WHERE      stl.VCRTYP_0 = 6      AND (%1% = '' OR stl.ITMREF_0 = %1%)      AND (%2% = '01/01/00' OR prh.RCPDAT_0 >= %2%)      AND (%3% = '01/01/00' OR prh.RCPDAT_0 <= %3%)      AND (%4% = '' OR itm.TCLCOD_0 = %4%)      AND (%5% = '' OR stl.BPSLOT_0 = %5%);

title: DPC Ventes/Consult ligne comma
description: Requête importée automatiquement depuis l'export SQL Sage X3.
sql: SELECT SOP.SOHNUM_0 as 'N° Commande'   ,SOH.ORDDAT_0 as 'Date commande'   ,SOP.SOPLIN_0 as 'Ligne'   ,SOP.SOQSTA_0 as 'Etat ligne'   ,SOH.CUSORDREF_0 as 'Référence commande client'   ,SOH.BPCORD_0 as 'Code client'   ,SOH.BPCNAM_0 as 'Raison sociale'   ,SOQ.DEMDLVDAT_0 as 'Date liv demandée'   ,SOQ.SHIDAT_0 as 'Date expédition'   ,ITM.TCLCOD_0 as 'Catégorie article'   ,SOP.ITMREF_0 as 'Code article'   ,SOP.ITMDES1_0 as 'Désignation article'   ,SOQ.QTY_0 as 'Qté cdée'   ,SOP.SAU_0 as 'Unité'   ,SOQ.ALLQTY_0 as 'Qté allouée'   ,SOQ.DLVQTY_0 as 'Qté livrée'   ,SOQ.INVQTY_0 as 'Qté facturée'   ,SOP.NETPRINOT_0 as 'Prix net HT'   ,SOH.CUR_0 as 'Devise'   ,SOP.NETPRINOT_0*SOQ.QTY_0 as 'Mt ligne HT'   ,SOP.NETPRIATI_0*SOQ.QTY_0 as 'Mt ligne TTC'   ,SOQ.SOHCAT_0 as 'Catégorie commande'   ,SOQ.XBPCLOT_0 as 'Extern batch number'    FROM SORDERP SOP   INNER JOIN SORDER SOH    ON SOH.SOHNUM_0 = SOP.SOHNUM_0   INNER JOIN SORDERQ SOQ    ON SOQ.SOHNUM_0 = SOP.SOHNUM_0    AND SOQ.SOPLIN_0 = SOP.SOPLIN_0   INNER JOIN ITMMASTER ITM    ON ITM.ITMREF_0 = SOP.ITMREF_0   INNER JOIN BPCUSTOMER BPC    ON BPC.BPCNUM_0 = SOP.BPCORD_0    WHERE ((%1% = '' and %2% = '') or (SOP.ITMREF_0 >= %1% and SOP.ITMREF_0 <= %2%))   AND ((%3% = '' and %4% = '') or (SOH.BPCORD_0 >= %3% and SOH.BPCORD_0 <= %4%))   AND ((%5% = '' and %6% = '') or (SOP.SOHNUM_0 >= %5% and SOP.SOHNUM_0 <= %6%))   AND (SOH.ORDDAT_0 BETWEEN %7% and %8%)   AND ((%9% = '' and %10% = '') or (SOP.SOQSTA_0 >= %9% and SOP.SOQSTA_0 <= %10%))   AND ((%11%= '' and %12% = '') or (ITM.YACTCOD_0 >= %11% and ITM.YACTCOD_0 <= %12%))

title: Suivi du stock CQPC
description: Requête importée automatiquement depuis l'export SQL Sage X3.
sql: WITH Resultats AS (  SELECT DISTINCT  STK.LOC_0 as 'Emplacement',  ITM.ITMREF_0 as 'Code article',  ITM.ITMDES1_0 as 'Désignation article',  COALESCE(SUM(STK.QTYSTU_0), 0) as 'Qté US',  ITM.STU_0 as 'Unité de stock',  ITF.REOTSD_0 as 'Seuil article',  ITF.MAXSTO_0 as 'Qté Max article',  CASE  WHEN COALESCE(SUM(STK.QTYSTU_0), 0) > STC.MAXSTO_0 AND STC.MAXSTO_0 > 0 THEN 'QTE MAX DEPASSEE'  WHEN (  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(STK3.QTYSTU_0), 0) FROM STOCK STK3 WHERE STK3.ITMREF_0 = ITM.ITMREF_0 AND STK3.LOCTYP_0 = 'CQPC') <= ITF.REOTSD_0  AND ITF.REOTSD_0 > 0  ) AND (  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(STK2.QTYSTU_0), 0) FROM STOCK STK2 WHERE STK2.ITMREF_0 = ITM.ITMREF_0) -  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(STK3.QTYSTU_0), 0) FROM STOCK STK3 WHERE STK3.ITMREF_0 = ITM.ITMREF_0 AND STK3.LOCTYP_0 = 'CQPC')  ) > 0 THEN 'A COMMANDER'  WHEN (  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(STK3.QTYSTU_0), 0) FROM STOCK STK3 WHERE STK3.ITMREF_0 = ITM.ITMREF_0 AND STK3.LOCTYP_0 = 'CQPC') <= ITF.REOTSD_0  AND ITF.REOTSD_0 > 0  ) THEN 'A COMMANDER'  WHEN (  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(STK3.QTYSTU_0), 0) FROM STOCK STK3 WHERE STK3.ITMREF_0 = ITM.ITMREF_0 AND STK3.LOCTYP_0 = 'CQPC') > ITF.MAXSTO_0  AND ITF.MAXSTO_0 > 0  ) THEN 'QTE MAX DEPASSEE'  WHEN COALESCE(SUM(STK.QTYSTU_0), 0) = 0 THEN 'AUCUN STOCK'  ELSE ''  END as 'Statut'  FROM ITMMASTER ITM  INNER JOIN ITMFACILIT ITF  ON ITF.ITMREF_0 = ITM.ITMREF_0  AND ITF.STOFCY_0 = 'VDP1F'  LEFT JOIN STOCK STK  ON STK.ITMREF_0 = ITM.ITMREF_0  AND STK.LOCTYP_0 = 'CQPC'  LEFT JOIN STOLOCAFF STC  ON STC.LOC_0 = STK.LOC_0  AND STC.STOFCY_0 = 'VDP1F'  AND STC.ITMREF_0 = ITM.ITMREF_0  WHERE ITM.ITMREF_0 LIKE 'L-CQPC%' or STK.LOCTYP_0 = 'CQPC'  GROUP BY  STK.LOC_0,  ITM.ITMREF_0,  ITM.ITMDES1_0,  ITM.STU_0,  STC.REOTSD_0,  STC.MAXSTO_0,  ITF.REOTSD_0,  ITF.MAXSTO_0  )  SELECT * FROM Resultats  ORDER BY  CASE Statut  WHEN 'A COMMANDER' THEN 1  WHEN 'QTE MAX DEPASSEE' THEN 2  WHEN 'AUCUN STOCK' THEN 3  ELSE 7  END,  [Code article];

title: Alertes commandes stock CQPC
description: Requête importée automatiquement depuis l'export SQL Sage X3.
sql: SELECT *  FROM (      SELECT          ITM.ITMREF_0 as Code_article,          ITM.ITMDES1_0 as Designation_article,          COALESCE(SUM(STK.QTYSTU_0), 0) as Qte_US,          ITM.STU_0 as Unite_stock,          ITF.REOTSD_0 as Seuil_article,          ITF.MAXSTO_0 as Qte_Max_article,            CASE              WHEN (                  COALESCE(SUM(STK.QTYSTU_0), 0) <= ITF.REOTSD_0                  AND ITF.REOTSD_0 > 0              ) THEN 'A COMMANDER'              WHEN COALESCE(SUM(STK.QTYSTU_0), 0) = 0 THEN 'AUCUN STOCK'              ELSE ''          END as Statut        FROM ITMMASTER ITM        INNER JOIN ITMFACILIT ITF          ON ITF.ITMREF_0 = ITM.ITMREF_0          AND ITF.STOFCY_0 = 'VDP1F'        LEFT JOIN STOCK STK          ON STK.ITMREF_0 = ITM.ITMREF_0          AND STK.LOCTYP_0 = 'CQPC'        LEFT JOIN STOLOCAFF STC          ON STC.LOC_0 = STK.LOC_0          AND STC.STOFCY_0 = 'VDP1F'          AND STC.ITMREF_0 = ITM.ITMREF_0        WHERE ITM.ITMREF_0 LIKE 'L-CQPC%' OR STK.LOCTYP_0 = 'CQPC'        GROUP BY          ITM.ITMREF_0,          ITM.ITMDES1_0,          ITM.STU_0,          STC.MAXSTO_0,          ITF.REOTSD_0,          ITF.MAXSTO_0   HAVING     COALESCE(SUM(STK.QTYSTU_0), 0) = 0 OR COALESCE(SUM(STK.QTYSTU_0), 0) <= ITF.REOTSD_0  ) Resultats    ORDER BY      CASE Statut          WHEN 'A COMMANDER' THEN 1          WHEN 'AUCUN STOCK' THEN 2          ELSE 3      END,      Code_article;

title: Suivi du stock CQPC
description: Requête importée automatiquement depuis l'export SQL Sage X3.
sql: SELECT      STK.LOC_0 as Emplacement,      ITM.ITMREF_0 as Code_article,      ITM.ITMDES1_0 as Designation_article,      STK.QTYSTU_0 as Qte_US,      ITM.STU_0 as Unite_stock,      ITF.REOTSD_0 as Seuil_article,      ITF.MAXSTO_0 as Qte_Max_article,      CASE          WHEN (              (SELECT SUM(STK2.QTYSTU_0)               FROM STOCK STK2               WHERE STK2.ITMREF_0 = ITM.ITMREF_0               AND STK2.LOCTYP_0 = 'CQPC') >= ITF.MAXSTO_0          ) THEN 'QTE MAX DEPASSEE'          WHEN (STK.QTYSTU_0 IS NULL) THEN 'AUCUN STOCK'          ELSE ''      END as Statut  FROM ITMMASTER ITM  INNER JOIN ITMFACILIT ITF      ON ITF.ITMREF_0 = ITM.ITMREF_0      AND ITF.STOFCY_0 = 'VDP1F'  LEFT JOIN STOCK STK      ON STK.ITMREF_0 = ITM.ITMREF_0      AND STK.LOCTYP_0 = 'CQPC'  LEFT JOIN STOLOCAFF STC      ON STC.LOC_0 = STK.LOC_0      AND STC.STOFCY_0 = 'VDP1F'      AND STC.ITMREF_0 = ITM.ITMREF_0  WHERE ITM.ITMREF_0 LIKE 'L-CQPC%' OR STK.LOCTYP_0 = 'CQPC'  ORDER BY      CASE WHEN STK.QTYSTU_0 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,      Emplacement, Code_article
